title: State Asset Management Strategy: Highest and Best Use Analysis to Increase Non-Tax Revenue
affiliations: Universitas Trisakti, Universitas Trisakti and Universitas Trisakti

detail.title: State Asset Management Strategy: Highest and Best Use Analysis to Increase Non-Tax Revenue

publicationDetails.detailsText: OIDA International Journal of Sustainable Development, 18 (12), 1423-1436, 2025.
publicationDetails.journalName: OIDA International Journal of Sustainable Development

detail.abstract: This study examines strategic approaches to state asset management aimed at enhancing Non-Tax State Revenue (PNBP) and strengthening fiscal sustainability in Indonesia. It develops an analytical framework for optimizing state asset utilization through the application of the Highest and Best Use (HBU) principle, while also exploring implementation strategies, success factors, coordination mechanisms, and the integration of digital technologies. A qualitative methodology was employed, incorporating a Systematic Literature Review, Focus Group Discussions with government officials and asset managers, and NVivo-assisted thematic analysis. The data collection process identified operational challenges and strategic opportunities within Indonesia's state asset management ecosystem. Findings reveal four critical dimensions for effective state asset management: (1) the implementation of good governance principles integrated with public finance management to generate both economic returns and social benefits; (2) the development of specialized expertise among State-Owned Asset (BMN) managers; (3) regulatory reform to simplify administrative procedures while enhancing transparency; and (4) the formulation of integrated management strategies aligned with national priorities through inter-agency synergy and collaboration with the private sector. Recommendations include institutionalizing good governance within asset management frameworks, empowering the State Asset Management Agency (LMAN) as a central coordination mechanism, accelerating the digitalization of asset information systems, implementing comprehensive capacity development programs, and pursuing targeted regulatory reforms. Future research should explore opportunities for technological integration and conduct comparative analyses with international best practices. This research contributes to the field by synthesizing the Highest and Best Use (HBU) methodology with governance principles in the management of state assets. The proposed framework offers evidence-based guidance for optimizing state asset utilization and enhancing non-tax revenue streams, thereby strengthening Indonesia's fiscal sustainability while supporting broader economic development goals.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨印尼国有资产管理的战略方法，通过最高最佳使用原则优化资产利用，提升非税国家收入，增强财政可持续性。研究提出包含治理、专业能力、法规改革和整合战略的四维框架。
AI.research_question: 如何通过战略性的国有资产管理方法优化资产利用，提升印尼的非税国家收入并增强财政可持续性？
AI.motivation: 印尼需要加强国有资产管理以增加非税收入来源，改善财政可持续性，支持经济发展目标。当前国有资产管理存在效率低下、协调不足等问题，需要系统性战略框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 最高最佳使用原则与治理原则的整合框架，结合公共财政管理理论，强调经济回报与社会效益的双重目标。
AI.method: 定性研究方法：系统性文献综述、与政府官员和资产管理者的焦点小组讨论、NVivo辅助的主题分析。
AI.findings: 发现有效国有资产管理的四个关键维度：1) 良好治理原则与公共财政管理的整合；2) 国有资产管理者的专业能力发展；3) 简化行政程序并增强透明度的法规改革；4) 通过跨机构协同和公私合作制定整合管理战略。
AI.theory_contributions: 将最高最佳使用方法论与治理原则在国有资产管理中综合，提出了整合性的理论框架，为优化国有资产利用提供理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出具体建议：在资产管理框架中制度化良好治理、强化国家资产管理机构作为中央协调机制、加速资产信息系统数字化、实施全面能力发展计划、推进针对性法规改革。

title: Beyond Personality: A Multidimensional IPPO Model for Aligning Personal Philosophy and Organizational Outcomes

detail.title: Beyond Personality: A Multidimensional IPPO Model for Aligning Personal Philosophy and Organizational Outcomes

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Declaration of Interest: Collaborative Research on the IPPO (Interest, Personality, Philosophy, Outcome) Model Subject: Call for Research Collaboration and Empirical Validation of the Multidimensional IPPO Framework To: The Global Research Community / Potential Research Partners I. Introduction & Purpose I am writing to express my strong interest in establishing professional collaborations with high-level researchers and academic institutions to further the development, empirical testing, and practical application of the IPPO (Interest, Personality, Philosophy, Outcome) Model. The IPPO model is an interdisciplinary framework that integrates personal philosophy as a measurable variable alongside traditional interest and personality metrics to foster "purpose compatibility" within organizations. II. The IPPO Model Overview The framework addresses the "crisis of purpose" in the modern workforce by moving beyond performance-oriented psychometrics to a holistic, values-based approach. It is built upon the equation Interest + Personality + Philosophy = Outcome. Theoretical Foundations: The model is grounded in Erik Erikson’s psychosocial development, Viktor Frankl’s Logotherapy, and Nietzschean existentialism. Operational Process: A five-phase methodology—Discover, Analyze, Interpret, Activate, and Sustain—designed for organizational integration. Managerial Impact: Includes the "3-Tier Managerial Philosophy Impact Model," which maps how a leader’s personal beliefs create a systemic ripple effect across an organization. III. Proposed Areas for Collaboration Recognizing that the model currently serves as a robust conceptual framework, I am seeking partners to assist in the following research phases as outlined in the manuscript: Instrument Development & Validation: Creating and validating a reliable, bias-free psychometric tool to assess the "Philosophy" component and its interaction with Interest and Personality. Longitudinal Organizational Studies: Tracking the correlation between high IPPO alignment and key outcomes such as reduced burnout, increased retention, and improved psychological well-being over time. Causal Relationship Testing: Conducting controlled experiments to test the impact of managerial philosophical awareness on departmental culture and performance. AI-Driven Philosophical Profiling: Exploring the ethical and technical integration of AI-driven profiling while addressing data privacy and algorithmic bias. IV. Commitment and Prospect I am seeking researchers who are interested in exploring the intersection of existential psychology and organizational behavior. My goal is to establish the IPPO framework as a robust, actionable tool that can serve as a public health intervention and a new paradigm for talent management. I am available for formal discussions regarding the feasibility, funding prospects, and methodological design of these research initiatives. Sincerely, MD. Sagor Ahmed Lead Developer, IPPO Model, E-mail: sahmed.bio@outlook.com & sahmedevergift@gmail.com

detail.abstract: Modern organizations, while structured for performance, often fail to address the fundamental human need for purpose and meaning, leading to widespread dissatisfaction. This paper introduces the IPPO (Interest, Personality, Philosophy, Outcome) model, an interdisciplinary framework designed to bridge this gap. Drawing on Erik Erikson's psychosocial stages, Viktor Frankl's Logotherapy, and Nietzschean existentialism, the model posits that core life philosophy is the primary determinant of well-being and performance. We outline an organizational methodology consisting of five phases: Discover, Analyze, Interpret, Activate, and Sustain. By implementing tools such as the IPPO Scorecard and Culture Heatmap, organizations can foster "purpose compatibility" rather than just productivity. Empirical evidence suggests that philosophical alignment is essential for improving job satisfaction, career adaptability, and psychological resilience.

AI.tldr: 本文提出IPPO模型，通过整合兴趣、人格、哲学和结果四个维度，帮助组织解决员工缺乏意义感的问题，实现哲学对齐以提升福祉和绩效。
AI.research_question: 如何通过哲学对齐来解决现代组织中普遍存在的意义缺失问题，从而提升员工福祉和组织绩效？
AI.motivation: 现代组织虽然追求绩效，但普遍忽视了人类对意义和目的的基本需求，导致广泛的不满和低效。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合了埃里克·埃里克森的心理社会发展阶段理论、维克多·弗兰克尔的意义治疗法以及尼采的存在主义哲学。
AI.method: 提出五阶段组织方法论：发现、分析、解释、激活和维持，使用IPPO计分卡和文化热图等工具。
AI.findings: 哲学对齐对于提高工作满意度、职业适应性和心理韧性至关重要，能够培养"目的兼容性"而不仅仅是生产力。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了IPPO跨学科框架，将存在主义哲学与组织管理相结合，强调核心生活哲学是福祉和绩效的主要决定因素。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织提供了具体的实施工具和方法论，帮助建立哲学对齐的文化，提升员工意义感和组织效能。

detail.title: Reimagining Women's Health: Crowdsourcing Topics and Questions that Matter

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No conflict of interest
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not Applicable
declarations.funderStatement: Gates Foundation

detail.abstract: Women's health remains under-resourced, underprioritized, and narrowly defined. Across the life course, women experience distinct health needs with significant implications for health and wellbeing, yet persistent gaps in evidence and data continue to reinforce inequities. In the absence of a universally accepted definition of women's health, this study aimed to develop a topic map to capture its breadth and to identify an evidence-informed set of the top ten priority questions to guide future women's health research and innovation. We used a participatory, iterative methodology inspired by the 100 Questions Initiative, combining structured stakeholder engagement, rapid evidence synthesis, and iterative validation. An initial topic map was developed through an in-person workshop and refined through ongoing engagement with 77 global experts in women's health and data science. Guided by the topic map, experts submitted research questions via a virtual survey, which were refined, clustered, prioritized, and ranked. The topic map served as a shared framework to guide the submission of actionable research questions and comprised four branches: (1) key domains of women's health; (2) determinants and barriers; (3) technology and innovation; and (4) research and evidence gaps. A total of 113 questions were submitted, clustered into 56 themes, and narrowed to a top ten through expert prioritization, followed by public ranking. The highest-ranked questions focused on reframing and prioritizing women's health, strengthening investment and innovation ecosystems, and addressing evidence gaps, research participation, data quality, and equity. This study presents a comprehensive topic map that captures the complexity of women's health and provides a unifying framework for the field. The prioritized questions offer a strategic foundation to guide future research, policy, and investment to advance women's health innovation.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过参与式方法开发了女性健康主题图谱，并确定了十大优先研究问题，为女性健康研究、政策和投资提供战略指导。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个全面的女性健康主题图谱，并确定指导未来研究和创新的十大优先研究问题？
AI.motivation: 女性健康长期面临资源不足、优先级低和定义狭窄的问题，证据和数据缺口持续加剧不平等。缺乏普遍接受的女性健康定义阻碍了系统性研究和创新。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于100 Questions Initiative的参与式方法论，结合利益相关者参与、快速证据综合和迭代验证。主题图谱作为共享框架，包含四个分支：女性健康关键领域、决定因素与障碍、技术与创新、研究与证据缺口。
AI.method: 采用参与式迭代方法：1）通过现场研讨会开发初始主题图谱；2）与77名全球专家持续参与完善；3）虚拟调查收集研究问题；4）问题提炼、聚类、优先级排序和排名；5）公众排名确定十大优先问题。
AI.findings: 开发了包含四个分支的全面女性健康主题图谱。收集113个问题，聚类为56个主题，最终确定十大优先问题，重点关注：重新定义和优先考虑女性健康、加强投资和创新生态系统、解决证据缺口、研究参与、数据质量和公平性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了首个全面捕捉女性健康复杂性的主题图谱，为领域提供了统一框架。建立了系统化识别研究优先问题的方法论，弥合了女性健康定义和研究议程的空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 十大优先问题为未来研究、政策和投资提供了战略基础。主题图谱可作为行动指南，帮助利益相关者协调努力，推动女性健康创新。研究结果可指导资源分配和干预措施设计。

title: The Role of Business During the Erosion of Liberal Democracy in Modi's India

detail.title: The Role of Business During the Erosion of Liberal Democracy in Modi's India
detail.abstract: This chapter, published here https://doi.org/10.1017/9781009605533.012 in the Cambridge University Press volume "The Politics of Corporations in 'New' India," edited by Rohit Varman, explores the reasons for the Indian business responses to Hindutva which have ranged from silence to open support. The essay considers material interests and greed as well as fear of reprisal from vindictive state agencies as well as the identity of corporate owners, professionals, and customers that align the interests of businesses with the regime. But the chapter also draws on some primary sources to discuss the courageous actions by businesspeople who supported the Bharat Jodo Yatra, organized by opposing political formations in 2023. The chapter also compares the stances of Indian corporations with those of American corporations under the Trump administration and concludes with some recommendations for business leaders who are interested in defending pluralist democracy.

AI.tldr: 该章节探讨了印度企业对印度教民族主义（Hindutva）的回应，从沉默到公开支持，分析了物质利益、恐惧报复、身份认同等因素，同时讨论了支持反对派政治活动的勇敢企业行为，并与美国企业在特朗普政府下的立场进行比较，最后为维护多元民主提出建议。
AI.research_question: 印度企业对印度教民族主义（Hindutva）的回应为何从沉默到公开支持？影响企业立场的主要因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 理解印度企业在政治环境变化中的行为模式，特别是面对印度教民族主义崛起时的不同回应，以及这些行为对民主政治的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合政治经济学、企业社会责任、身份政治理论，分析企业政治行为的动机和影响因素。
AI.method: 文献分析、案例研究（包括对支持Bharat Jodo Yatra的企业行为分析）、比较研究（印度与美国企业政治立场比较）、基于一手资料的分析。
AI.findings: 印度企业对Hindutva的回应受多种因素影响：1）物质利益和贪婪；2）对报复性国家机构的恐惧；3）企业所有者、专业人士和客户的身份认同与政权利益一致。同时存在勇敢支持反对派政治活动的企业行为。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了企业政治行为理论，特别是在威权倾向政权下的企业回应模式；提出了身份认同在塑造企业政治立场中的重要作用；丰富了比较政治经济学中企业-国家关系的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为关注维护多元民主的企业领导者提供具体建议；揭示了企业在政治压力下的策略选择；为公民社会和民主倡导者理解企业政治行为提供参考。

title: Labor Market Competition and Corporate Disclosure
affiliations: University of Zurich and University of Zurich

detail.title: Labor Market Competition and Corporate Disclosure
detail.abstract: Recent research shows that corporate disclosures are important in the interaction between firms and labor markets. Yet, empirical evidence on how labor market dynamics affect corporate disclosure practices behavior remains limited. Exploiting newly available firm-year and firmpair-year measures of labor market competition, we show that firms facing greater labor market competition adjust their disclosures in ways consistent with strategic labor market signaling. Firms with more labor market competition also align their disclosures more closely with labormarket peers, suggesting that competition for labor is associated with a convergence in disclosure practices. Together, our findings highlight labor market competition as an important and previously unexplored determinant of corporate disclosure practices.

AI.tldr: 研究发现劳动力市场竞争会影响企业信息披露行为，企业面临更激烈的劳动力市场竞争时会调整信息披露以进行战略性劳动力市场信号传递，并与劳动力市场同行保持更一致的信息披露实践。
AI.research_question: 劳动力市场竞争如何影响企业信息披露实践行为？
AI.motivation: 虽然已有研究表明企业信息披露在企业和劳动力市场互动中很重要，但关于劳动力市场动态如何影响企业信息披露实践的实证证据仍然有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 战略性劳动力市场信号传递理论、信息披露趋同理论
AI.method: 利用新近可得的公司年度和公司配对年度劳动力市场竞争度量指标进行实证分析
AI.findings: 1. 面临更激烈劳动力市场竞争的企业会调整信息披露，这与战略性劳动力市场信号传递一致；2. 劳动力市场竞争更激烈的企业其信息披露与劳动力市场同行更加一致，表明劳动力竞争与信息披露实践趋同相关
AI.theory_contributions: 将劳动力市场竞争确立为企业信息披露实践的重要且先前未被探索的决定因素，拓展了信息披露理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业管理者提供了在劳动力市场竞争环境下如何调整信息披露策略的实践指导，帮助投资者理解企业信息披露行为背后的劳动力市场动因

title: Philosophical Understanding of Cultural Processes in Human Development
affiliations: Ukrainian State University of Science and Technologies, Ukrainian State University of Science and Technologies, Taras Shevchenko National University «Chernihiv Collegium»,, Lviv State University of Life Safety and Interregional Academy of Personnel Management

detail.title: Philosophical Understanding of Cultural Processes in Human Development

publicationDetails.detailsText: OIDA International Journal of Sustainable Development, 18 (12), 1471-1484, 2025.
publicationDetails.journalName: OIDA International Journal of Sustainable Development

detail.abstract: Philosophical and cultural studies aim to explore the structure, functions, and role of culture within society. Specifically, the philosophy of cultural phenomena seeks to identify key evolutionary cultural trends and understand the causes of crisis phenomena. To analyze these processes, a periodization of philosophical doctrines has been carried out, allowing for a systematic understanding of cultural development. It is argued that the synergy between philosophy and culture forms a unique reflexive and conceptual foundation for the cultural advancement of society, providing integrity, orderliness, and the rationalization of individual elements within the social system. The study also considers cultural and human activity through a historical and philosophical lens, highlighting the evolution of social development over time. The research demonstrates that traditional models of philosophical knowledge, aligned with order, balance, stability, and determinism, are increasingly inadequate in addressing the complexities of the modern world, characterized by chaos, imbalance, instability, and variability. Nonetheless, ideas derived from synergism retain significant paradigmatic relevance today. The philosophical nature of cultural aspects is interpreted as the development of the human position within historical and temporal contexts, emphasizing the logic of philosophical concepts in shaping societal cultural progress. The study also examines the interaction between social and cultural advancement, considering the challenges posed by globalization. Cultural dynamics are identified as a form of self-organization of meanings and values within the social space, closely linked to technological modernization. Four principal philosophical dimensions of cultural evolution are formulated: anthropological, ethicalreflecting emerging moral guidelines amid cultural pluralism-ontological, and epistemological. A model of cultural dynamics as a synergistic process integrating tradition, innovation, and value exchange is proposed. Comparative analysis shows that philosophical approaches offer a more comprehensive understanding of cultural evolution than purely sociological models. The concept of "cultural balance" is introduced as a prerequisite for sustainable societal development, ensuring a harmonious integration of traditions, values, and innovations, thereby fostering social stability, sustainable development, and global competitiveness.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨哲学与文化之间的协同关系，认为传统哲学模型已不足以应对现代世界的复杂性，但协同主义思想仍具范式相关性。研究提出了文化动态的协同过程模型和"文化平衡"概念，强调哲学方法比纯社会学模型更能全面理解文化进化。
AI.research_question: 哲学如何为文化发展提供反思性和概念性基础？传统哲学模型在现代复杂世界中的局限性是什么？如何通过哲学维度理解文化进化？
AI.motivation: 传统哲学模型（强调秩序、平衡、稳定和决定论）已无法充分应对现代世界的复杂性（混乱、失衡、不稳定和可变性），需要探索哲学与文化之间的协同关系以理解文化进化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 协同主义理论、文化哲学、历史哲学、文化动态理论、文化平衡概念、哲学与文化协同理论。
AI.method: 哲学学说分期法、历史哲学分析、比较分析（哲学方法与纯社会学模型）、概念模型构建（文化动态协同过程模型）。
AI.findings: 1. 哲学与文化协同形成社会文化进步的独特反思性和概念性基础；2. 传统哲学模型在现代复杂世界中存在局限性；3. 协同主义思想仍具范式相关性；4. 文化动态是社会空间中意义和价值的自组织形式；5. 提出文化进化的四个哲学维度；6. 哲学方法比纯社会学模型更能全面理解文化进化；7. "文化平衡"是可持续发展的前提。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出哲学与文化协同的理论框架；2. 构建文化动态作为协同过程的模型；3. 提出文化进化的四个哲学维度；4. 引入"文化平衡"概念作为可持续发展理论；5. 论证哲学方法在文化研究中的优越性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为理解文化进化提供哲学分析工具；2. 为应对全球化挑战提供理论指导；3. 为促进社会稳定性、可持续发展和全球竞争力提供"文化平衡"框架；4. 为文化政策制定提供哲学基础。

title: How Parent Resource Allocation Shapes Group Productivity: The Contingent Role of Subsidiary Traits
affiliations: , , , Shanghai University of International Business and Economics and

detail.title: How Parent Resource Allocation Shapes Group Productivity: The Contingent Role of Subsidiary Traits
detail.abstract: This study investigates how parent company resource allocation strategies influence group-level total factor productivity (TFP) within business groups, with particular attention to the moderating effects of subsidiary traits such as autonomy and diversification. Based on a panel dataset of Chinese A-share listed firms with controlling subsidiaries from 2007 to 2022, we employ a two-way fixed effects model to assess how resource allocation influences group-level TFP, while considering the moderating roles of subsidiary autonomy and diversification. We also implement a comprehensive suite of robustness assessments, including alternative measurement strategies, placebo analyses, and instrumental variable estimations. Our findings suggest that a resource allocation strategy oriented toward operating assets is positively associated with group-level TFP. However, this positive effect diminishes in the presence of greater subsidiary autonomy and diversification. Further analysis indicates that operating asset-oriented resource allocation fosters innovation investment, which subsequently enhances boosts group-level TFP. Moreover, this mechanism is more salient in regions with higher levels of marketization, in cities characterized by stronger innovation capacity, and within industries facing more intense competition. The findings extend the Resource-based View to the business group context, contributing both theoretically and practically by informing the optimization of resource allocation strategies to enhance overall group performance.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨母公司资源分配策略如何影响企业集团层面的全要素生产率，重点关注子公司自主权和多元化程度的调节作用。研究发现，以经营性资产为导向的资源分配策略能提升集团TFP，但这一正向效应在子公司自主权和多元化程度较高时会减弱。机制分析表明，经营性资产导向的资源分配通过促进创新投资来提升TFP，这一机制在市场化和创新水平较高、竞争更激烈的环境中更为显著。
AI.research_question: 母公司资源分配策略如何影响企业集团层面的全要素生产率？子公司自主权和多元化程度如何调节这种影响？
AI.motivation: 企业集团内部资源分配对整体绩效的影响机制尚不明确，特别是在考虑子公司特征（如自主权和多元化）的调节作用时。理解这些关系有助于优化集团资源配置，提升整体效率。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资源基础观（Resource-based View），扩展至企业集团情境。关注资源分配策略、子公司特征（自主权、多元化）与集团绩效的关系。
AI.method: 基于2007-2022年中国A股上市公司及其控股子公司的面板数据，采用双向固定效应模型分析资源分配对集团TFP的影响。进行稳健性检验，包括替代测量策略、安慰剂分析和工具变量估计。
AI.findings: 1. 以经营性资产为导向的资源分配策略与集团TFP正相关；2. 子公司自主权和多元化程度会削弱这一正向效应；3. 机制分析表明，经营性资产导向的资源分配通过促进创新投资提升TFP；4. 这一机制在市场化和创新水平较高、竞争更激烈的环境中更为显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 将资源基础观扩展至企业集团情境，揭示了资源分配策略与集团绩效的关系，并阐明了子公司特征的调节作用，丰富了企业集团治理和资源配置理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业集团优化资源配置策略提供实践指导，建议在制定资源分配策略时考虑子公司自主权和多元化程度，并重视通过创新投资提升集团整体效率。

title: Mental Peculiarities of Metaphor Formation in European Idioms: Mutual Influence and Common Features
affiliations: University of Nyíregyhaza, University of Nyíregyhaza, Uzhhorod National University, Ferenc Rákoczi II Transcarpathian Hungarian College of Higher Education and Ferenc Rákoczi II Transcarpathian Hungarian College of Higher Education

detail.title: Mental Peculiarities of Metaphor Formation in European Idioms: Mutual Influence and Common Features

publicationDetails.detailsText: OIDA International Journal of Sustainable Development, 18 (12), 1455-1462, 2025.
publicationDetails.journalName: OIDA International Journal of Sustainable Development

detail.abstract: The article describes the processes of nomination, which are relevant for modern linguistics and are based on metaphorization of reality. The aim of the article is to study the cognitive aspects of metaphorization in modern European languages. The article describes the process of metaphorization in language through the imposition of secondary meaning on the primary one; describes the process of forming a linguistic picture of the world that is unique for each language community; investigates metaphorization at different levels of language (lexical, phrasal, phraseological); describes the peculiarities of metaphorization of neologisms based on the analysis of corpora of English and Polish texts. The article is based on the syncretism of descriptive, comparative, synthesis and analysis methods, systematic method in combination with the method of generalization. It is shown that the modification of metaphorical models occurs mainly due to the involvement of neologisms as a source of metaphorization, the activation of such established semantic spheres as high technology, economics and finance, and mass culture in this function. In European languages, the main cognitive structures are dominated by substantive metaphor, whose function is to nominate new realities of the surrounding reality. Due to the analytical nature of the English language, a significant number of partial metaphors function in it, realized with the help of complex words and stable phrases. Metaphors-neologisms are found in different styles of speech: scientific, formal business, journalistic, colloquial. It has been established that the linguistic picture of the world presented in the metaphorical subsystems of English and Polish is anthropocentric in nature, since one of the most productive areas of metaphorization is the human being. It has been determined that in the field of communication, linguistic metaphor in English and Polish fulfills all the functions traditionally attributed to it, i.e. communicative, nominative, expressive and characteristic. In the studied European languages, all the traditionally distinguished types of metaphor are observed, i.e. metonymy, hyperbole, euphemism, periphrasis. Metaphor is used to evaluate reality, express the speaker's attitude to the surrounding realities of the world, and form the cognitive (mental) and linguistic worldviews of speakers.

AI.tldr: 本文研究现代欧洲语言中隐喻化的认知方面，探讨隐喻如何通过次要意义叠加在主要意义上形成语言的世界图景，分析英语和波兰语中新词隐喻化的特点，发现隐喻模型主要通过新词、高科技、经济金融和大众文化等语义领域进行修改。
AI.research_question: 现代欧洲语言中隐喻化的认知机制是什么？隐喻在不同语言层面（词汇、短语、习语）如何运作？英语和波兰语中新词隐喻化有哪些特点？
AI.motivation: 隐喻化过程对现代语言学具有重要意义，它能揭示语言如何通过认知机制构建独特的世界图景，理解不同语言社区如何通过隐喻表达现实。
AI.theoretical_framework: 认知语言学、隐喻理论、语言世界图景理论、人类中心主义语言观、语言功能理论（交际、命名、表达、特征功能）
AI.method: 描述法、比较法、综合分析法、系统方法结合概括法，基于英语和波兰语语料库分析
AI.findings: 1. 隐喻模型主要通过新词作为隐喻源进行修改，高科技、经济金融和大众文化等语义领域被激活；2. 欧洲语言中实体隐喻占主导，用于命名新现实；3. 英语因分析性特点，大量部分隐喻通过复合词和固定短语实现；4. 新词隐喻出现在各种语体中；5. 英语和波兰语隐喻子系统呈现人类中心主义特征；6. 隐喻在交际中实现所有传统功能；7. 所有传统隐喻类型都存在；8. 隐喻用于评价现实、表达态度、形成认知和语言世界观
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对隐喻化认知机制的理解，扩展了语言世界图景理论，验证了人类中心主义在隐喻形成中的作用，丰富了跨语言隐喻比较研究
AI.practical_contributions: 为语言教学提供隐喻认知视角，为跨文化交际提供理解框架，为词典编纂和术语标准化提供参考，为语言政策制定提供依据

title: Smart Agriculture: Digital Technologies as a Factor of Rapid Growth of Companies in the Russian Food Market
affiliations: MGIMO (Moscow State University of International Relations)

detail.title: Smart Agriculture: Digital Technologies as a Factor of Rapid Growth of Companies in the Russian Food Market
detail.abstract: This report is devoted to the study of the role of smart agriculture in the dynamic growth of Russian agricultural companies in the domestic food market. The author examines the potential of the latest technological solutions and digitalization of production processes to increase the efficiency of agricultural holdings and medium-sized farms. Special attention is paid to such aspects as labor automation, precision farming, the use of big data and machine learning. Practical cases of Russian companies that have managed to significantly increase their competitiveness through the integration of smart technologies are presented. The report highlights the challenges and barriers preventing a massive transition to new standards for agricultural activities, including financial constraints, a shortage of qualified personnel, and a lack of clear standards. Finally, government support measures and concrete steps for the sustainable technological development of the industry are proposed.

title: The Ethical Values in Teaching English
affiliations: and

detail.title: The Ethical Values in Teaching English
detail.abstract: This paper explores the ethical dimensions inherent in the teaching of English as a second or foreign language (ESL/EFL), emphasizing the moral responsibilities educators bear in fostering inclusive, equitable, and culturally sensitive learning environments. Drawing on ethical frameworks such as virtue ethics, deontology, and consequentialism, the study examines key issues including cultural bias in curricula, the promotion of linguistic diversity versus standardization, and the ethical implications of assessment practices that may perpetuate inequalities. Through a qualitative analysis of case studies from diverse educational contexts, including classrooms in Asia, Europe, and North America, the research highlights how ethical decision-making in pedagogy can mitigate power imbalances and enhance learner autonomy. Findings reveal that integrating ethical values-such as respect, fairness, and social justice-into teaching strategies not only improves educational outcomes but also contributes to broader societal goals of intercultural understanding. The paper concludes with recommendations for teacher training programs to incorporate ethical reflection, underscoring the need for ongoing dialogue in the field to address emerging challenges like digital ethics in online language instruction. This work contributes to the discourse on professional ethics in language education, advocating for a pedagogy that prioritizes human dignity alongside linguistic proficiency.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨英语作为第二语言/外语教学中的伦理维度，强调教师在营造包容、公平和文化敏感学习环境中的道德责任，并提出将伦理反思纳入教师培训的建议。
AI.research_question: 英语作为第二语言/外语教学中存在哪些伦理维度？教师如何通过伦理决策促进包容、公平和文化敏感的学习环境？
AI.motivation: 英语教学实践中存在文化偏见、评估不平等、权力失衡等伦理问题，需要系统探讨教师道德责任以改善教学实践和社会公正。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于美德伦理学、义务论和结果主义等伦理框架，分析语言教学中的伦理决策和道德责任。
AI.method: 采用定性研究方法，对来自亚洲、欧洲和北美等不同教育背景的案例研究进行分析。
AI.findings: 研究发现：1）将尊重、公平和社会正义等伦理价值融入教学策略能改善教育成果；2）伦理决策能减轻权力失衡并增强学习者自主性；3）促进跨文化理解有助于实现更广泛的社会目标。

title: Ethics in Teacher-Students Relationships

detail.title: Ethics in Teacher-Students Relationships
detail.abstract: This study examines the urgency of ethics in building a harmonious relationship between teachers and students to create a supportive and productive learning environment. Ethics, which include moral principles, professional attitude, fairness, and respect, are an important foundation in educational interactions. A review of the literature shows that although teaching materials and learning methods have evolved, the learning process can be hampered if interpersonal relationships are not harmonious. The current phenomenon indicates an ethical shift, characterized by a decline in students' respect for teachers and the increasingly blurred boundaries of professionalism. The study identifies essential ethics that need to be applied by both parties: student ethics include courtesy, caring, and patience; Meanwhile, teacher ethics involves a friendly, democratic, and humane attitude

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了师生关系中伦理道德的紧迫性，强调道德原则、专业态度、公平和尊重是教育互动的重要基础，并提出了师生双方应遵循的具体伦理规范。

title: Basic Concepts of Ethics, Morals, and the Profession
affiliations: Universitas Cokroaminoto Palopo

detail.title: Basic Concepts of Ethics, Morals, and the Profession
detail.abstract: The concepts of Morals, Ethics, and Profession are three fundamental pillars that form the framework for individual and group behavior, particularly in professional work environments. A comprehensive understanding of these three concepts is crucial to creating a society and professional practice that is responsible, fair, and high in integrity. Morality (or Morality) refers to the personal values and beliefs that distinguish between right and wrong in individual behavior. It is often internal, based on conscience, tradition, or religious teachings, and serves as a basic compass in everyday decision-making. Ethics is the systematic study and philosophical reflection on morality. Ethics serves as a set of socially or professionally agreed-upon principles or standards for governing behavior. In a general context, ethics are rules of conduct derived from external sources (e.g., professional codes of conduct). Ethics is divided into three main branches: metaethics (the origins and meaning of ethical concepts), normative ethics (practical moral standards for determining correct behavior), and applied ethics (the application of moral standards in specific situations, such as business or medicine). A profession is defined not simply as an occupation, but as one that requires specialized education, intensive training, and a commitment to public service. The key characteristics of a profession include: a structured body of knowledge, autonomy in practice, and, most importantly, a Code of Professional Ethics.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了道德、伦理和职业这三个构成专业行为框架的基本支柱，分析了它们之间的关系及其在专业实践中的重要性。
AI.research_question: 道德、伦理和职业这三个概念如何相互作用，共同构成专业行为的基本框架？
AI.motivation: 理解道德、伦理和职业之间的关系对于建立负责任、公平和高诚信的社会及专业实践至关重要，但目前对这些概念的整合性理解还不够充分。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于道德哲学（个人价值观）、伦理理论（社会规范）和职业社会学（专业特征）的理论框架，分析三者的内在联系。
AI.method: 概念分析和理论整合方法，通过对道德、伦理和职业的定义、特征和相互关系进行系统性梳理和理论建构。
AI.findings: 道德是个人行为的内在指南，伦理是社会规范的系统化体现，而职业则是将道德和伦理原则具体化为专业实践的制度化形式。三者相互依存，共同构成专业行为的基本框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个整合道德、伦理和职业的三维理论框架，阐明了它们之间的层次关系和相互作用机制，丰富了专业伦理理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为专业教育和实践提供了清晰的指导框架，帮助专业人员更好地理解和应用道德伦理原则，促进负责任的专业实践和社会诚信建设。

detail.title: AI Driven Supply Chain Management System
detail.abstract: Logistics are one of the most important aspects in the management of a business, it also contributes significantly in the expenses incurred by a business. A supply chain without proper logistics is prone to delays in every part of the production chain from manufacturing to retail. It is therefore imperative for a business to properly manage their logistics and supply chains for an efficient management of resources and maximization of profits. The current rise of Artificial Intelligence applications opens new horizons of expansion within logistics, thus streamlining this difficult process. This paper details a web application which utilizes artificial intelligence in order to assist businesses in "Supply Chain Management" and optimization. It is also capable of "Inventory Management" and "Demand Forecasting" which allows businesses to analyze their inventory and make decision to either keep it or sell it prematurely based on the circumstances. It can also ascertain which products are selling well and advise whether to buy stock or not. These allow businesses to save money and time in excess inventory and supply chain inefficiencies.

title: Towards Improving Quality of Service in Industrial Networks: A Study on the Impact of Various Factors on Performance Parameters
affiliations: Al-Rasheed Private University

detail.title: Towards Improving Quality of Service in Industrial Networks: A Study on the Impact of Various Factors on Performance Parameters
detail.abstract: Industrial communication networks play a crucial role in ensuring the efficiency and reliability of automated systems. This study presents a practical and simulation-based approach to evaluate the performance of the MODBUS-RTU protocol, one of the most widely adopted industrial protocols. A physical circuit was implemented consisting of two interconnected units-a Master and a Slave-designed to measure key performance parameters such as frame delay and frame rate. In parallel, a simulation model was developed using the OPNET network simulator to replicate the same communication scenario and validate its accuracy. The results showed strong agreement between the realworld measurements and the simulation outcomes, with an error margin not exceeding 0.25%. This confirms both the high performance of the MODBUS-RTU protocol and the reliability of the OPNET simulator for modeling industrial networks. The study further highlights the impact of various factors on network performance, paving the way for future improvements in Quality of Service (QoS) through both experimental and simulation-based methods.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过实验和仿真相结合的方法评估MODBUS-RTU工业通信协议的性能，构建了主从单元物理电路测量帧延迟和帧速率，同时使用OPNET网络模拟器建立仿真模型。结果显示实验测量与仿真结果高度一致（误差不超过0.25%），验证了MODBUS-RTU协议的高性能和OPNET模拟器在工业网络建模中的可靠性。
AI.research_question: 如何准确评估MODBUS-RTU工业通信协议的性能表现？实验测量与仿真模拟结果之间的一致性如何？
AI.motivation: 工业通信网络对自动化系统的效率和可靠性至关重要，MODBUS-RTU作为最广泛采用的工业协议之一，需要对其性能进行准确评估。目前缺乏结合实验测量和仿真验证的综合评估方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 工业通信网络性能评估理论、MODBUS-RTU协议原理、网络仿真建模理论、实验验证方法学。
AI.method: 采用实验与仿真相结合的方法：1）构建包含主从单元的物理电路测量帧延迟和帧速率等关键性能参数；2）使用OPNET网络模拟器建立相同的通信场景仿真模型；3）对比分析实验测量与仿真结果。
AI.findings: 实验测量与仿真结果高度一致，误差不超过0.25%，验证了MODBUS-RTU协议的高性能和OPNET模拟器的可靠性。研究还揭示了各种因素对网络性能的影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）建立了工业通信协议性能评估的综合方法框架；2）验证了实验与仿真相结合方法的有效性；3）为工业网络建模提供了理论支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）提供了MODBUS-RTU协议性能评估的具体实施方案；2）证明了OPNET模拟器在工业网络分析中的实用性；3）为未来通过实验和仿真方法改进服务质量（QoS）奠定了基础。

title: The Exoneration Paradox: State Constitutional Remedies for Wrongful Convictions A 50-State Comparative Analysis with Empirical Data
affiliations: Independent Scholar

detail.title: The Exoneration Paradox: State Constitutional Remedies for Wrongful Convictions A 50-State Comparative Analysis with Empirical Data

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This manuscript was developed using AI as a research and organizational tool. All substantive analysis, legal arguments, theoretical frameworks, and empirical findings are the author's original work. All factual claims have been independently verified against primary sources. The author maintains full intellectual ownership of this Article and certifies adherence to rigorous academic standards.

detail.abstract: This Article presents the first comprehensive 50-state analysis of state constitutional provisions applicable to wrongful convictions and their relationship to compensation statutes. Drawing on data from the National Registry of Exonerations documenting 3,698 exonerations since 1989,¹ this research reveals a constitutional paradox: states officially document their wrongful convictions through participation in national databases while simultaneously denying meaningful remedies to the innocent. As of October 2025, only 38 states and the District of Columbia provide statutory compensation, leaving 12 states with no compensation framework whatsoever.² This Article argues that state constitutions-interpreted independently from increasingly restrictive federal precedent-provide a viable path forward. Many state constitutions contain provisions with no federal analogue, use distinct textual formulations, and have their own interpretive histories that support broader protections than federal due process doctrine.³ The "Documentation Paradox" framework demonstrates that states' official recognition of wrongful convictions through exoneration registries establishes documented knowledge of systemic failures, transforming negligent denial of compensation into intentional constitutional violations under state law. The Article develops a typology of state constitutional provisions relevant to wrongful convictions, analyzes empirical patterns in exoneration and compensation data, and provides state-specific litigation roadmaps for deploying state constitutional claims. This framework is particularly critical for Black and brown exonerees, who face official misconduct at higher rates and are seven times more likely than white Americans to be wrongfully convicted of serious crimes.⁴

AI.tldr: 本文首次对美国50个州的宪法条款与冤案赔偿法规进行全面分析，揭示了一个宪法悖论：各州通过国家数据库记录冤案，却同时拒绝为无辜者提供有效救济。
AI.research_question: 州宪法条款如何为冤案受害者提供比联邦法律更有效的赔偿途径？
AI.motivation: 截至2025年10月，仍有12个州没有冤案赔偿框架，而国家冤案登记处记录了自1989年以来的3,698起冤案平反，形成"记录悖论"。
AI.theoretical_framework: "记录悖论"框架：各州通过参与国家冤案数据库正式记录冤案，建立了对系统性失败的文件化认知，使拒绝赔偿从过失行为转变为州法下的故意宪法侵权。
AI.method: 1. 对50个州宪法条款进行类型学分析；2. 分析冤案平反与赔偿数据的实证模式；3. 为各州制定具体的诉讼路线图。
AI.findings: 1. 只有38个州和哥伦比亚特区有法定赔偿法规；2. 州宪法包含无联邦对应条款的规定、独特的文本表述和独立的解释历史；3. 黑人和有色人种冤案受害者面临更高比例的官方不当行为。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次建立州宪法条款与冤案赔偿的全面分析框架；2. 提出"记录悖论"理论解释州政府行为矛盾；3. 论证州宪法可作为独立于联邦先例的有效救济途径。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为各州提供具体的诉讼策略路线图；2. 特别关注黑人和有色人种冤案受害者的司法需求；3. 推动州宪法解释的独立发展以扩大冤案保护。

title: The Evolving Value of the MBA: External Factors and Career Impact

detail.title: The Evolving Value of the MBA: External Factors and Career Impact

AI.tldr: 本研究基于波兰132名MBA毕业生的实证数据，探讨了MBA项目的感知价值，发现专业网络和个人成长是最重要的收获，超越了传统指标如晋升或学术知识。
AI.research_question: 从国际视角看，专业人士如何评估MBA学习对职业发展、技能提升特别是专业网络建设的价值？
AI.motivation: 在全球关于管理教育角色和相关性的大背景下，了解MBA项目在不同文化和制度环境中的实际价值，特别是在中欧和东欧地区缺乏相关实证研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于国际MBA项目和职业发展文献，关注管理教育的价值评估框架，特别是网络资本理论在职业发展中的作用。
AI.method: 定量研究方法，对波兰132名MBA毕业生进行跨行业调查，使用相关性和方差分析等统计方法，分析动机、网络效果和感知结果。
AI.findings: 网络建设和个人成长被认为是最有价值的成果，超越了晋升或学术知识等传统指标；学习期间有效网络与专业联系人扩展呈中度正相关；尽管当地机构受到公共丑闻影响，大多数毕业生仍对MBA经历持积极看法。
AI.theory_contributions: 为中欧和东欧地区MBA项目研究提供了稀缺的实证证据；为国际管理教育文献贡献了跨文化和制度环境的比较视角；深化了对网络资本在职业发展中作用的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议商学院加强结构化、国际化的网络机会；增强项目可信度；为不同全球市场的经验丰富的专业人士定制内容。

title: Digital Data as Dual-Value Assets: Shadow Banking as the Primary Financial Pathway and Commercial Banks as Dependent Amplifiers in China’s Digital Financing Networks

detail.title: Digital Data as Dual-Value Assets: Shadow Banking as the Primary Financial Pathway and Commercial Banks as Dependent Amplifiers in China’s Digital Financing Networks
detail.abstract: This study proposes a new mechanism to explain how digital data create financial value in emerging digital economies. Existing literature has emphasized the role of digitalization in reducing information frictions, but has not distinguished between who provides financing and how data are transformed into credit. Based on observations from China’s digital transaction networks, this paper identifies a dual-value structure of data assets: a primary financial pathway through shadow banking and a secondary pathway through commercial banks. Shadow banking institutions—platform firms, factoring companies, and other non-bank financial intermediaries—use digitally exposed transaction flows to perform real-time verification, providing the core channel of data-driven financing. Commercial banks, in contrast, rely on these verified data to convert future cash flows into pledgeable, auditable assets, making bank financing a dependent amplification effect rather than an independent mechanism. This dual-pathway framework clarifies the formation of data’s financial value and offers a structural explanation for China’s unique credit creation process in the digital era.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一个双重价值结构框架，解释数字数据如何在新兴数字经济中创造金融价值。研究发现，影子银行机构通过实时验证数字交易流提供核心的数据驱动融资渠道，而商业银行则依赖这些已验证数据将未来现金流转化为可质押、可审计的资产，形成依赖性的放大效应而非独立机制。
AI.research_question: 数字数据如何在新兴数字经济中创造金融价值？具体来说，谁提供融资以及数据如何转化为信贷？
AI.motivation: 现有文献强调数字化减少信息摩擦的作用，但未能区分融资提供者以及数据如何转化为信贷的具体机制。基于对中国数字交易网络的观察，需要解释数据资产的双重价值结构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数据资产的双重价值结构框架：主要金融路径通过影子银行，次要路径通过商业银行。影子银行机构（平台企业、保理公司等非银行金融中介）利用数字暴露的交易流进行实时验证，提供核心的数据驱动融资渠道。
AI.method: 基于对中国数字交易网络的观察，识别数据资产的双重价值结构，分析影子银行和商业银行在数据驱动融资中的不同角色和机制。
AI.findings: 影子银行机构通过实时验证数字交易流提供核心的数据驱动融资渠道；商业银行依赖这些已验证数据将未来现金流转化为可质押、可审计的资产，形成依赖性的放大效应而非独立机制。这解释了数据金融价值的形成和中国在数字时代独特的信贷创造过程。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了数据资产双重价值结构框架，澄清了数据金融价值的形成机制；解释了影子银行和商业银行在数据驱动融资中的不同角色；为中国数字时代的独特信贷创造过程提供了结构性解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解新兴数字经济中的金融价值创造提供了新视角；有助于政策制定者更好地监管数字金融创新；为企业如何利用数字数据获取融资提供了实践指导；解释了为什么中国在数字时代形成了独特的信贷创造模式。

title: Government Repression of the Public Majority: Things are Objectively Bad, 83 Bench & Bar of Minnesota __ (Jan-Feb 2026) (forthcoming)
affiliations: Ohio State University (OSU) - Michael E. Moritz College of Law

detail.title: Government Repression of the Public Majority: Things are Objectively Bad, 83 Bench & Bar of Minnesota __ (Jan-Feb 2026) (forthcoming)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I am a member of the Minnesota bar.

detail.abstract: How civically bad are things in the United States?  This bar journal essay grapples with this question that is getting constant discussion and thought by the public and legal community. This essay contends that things are not just subjectively bad for the Trump Administration's critics but are objectively bad. The essay looks to four data points. First, there is extensive evidence that the Trump Administration is pressing radical changes to the operation of our constitutional system and its ability to uphold the rule of law, not the rule of men – or of one man. Second, is the Trump Administration’s sweeping effort to punish, de-fund, and intimidate anyone disfavored by the term-limited President and his team, and in particular the political opposition, other critics, and lawyers who provide them legal representation.  Third is growing evidence of uncharacteristic unwillingness of too many lawyers to represent government-targeted clients, or even to write frankly and critically about the Trump Administration.  The chilling of First Amendment free speech is widely evident, including in this essay’s origins: it is a freestanding piece and not part of a planned symposium because this bar journal in a major legal market could not find enough lawyers willing to write about the obviously analysis-worth topic of a new presidential administration and the law.  The fourth data point is that a majority of Americans hold critical views of the President and his policies.  Consideration of these four factors together illuminates a glaring and grave problem in our civic space: the current President is pressing radical constitutional change and is targeting critics, generating clear evidence that many in the legal profession and among the general public feel chilled in their freedom to criticize the government – and even worse the Executive is using government to repress critics when critics are the majority.  If there is such a thing as an objective problem in a republic, repression of the majority qualifies.  If repression of free speech and legal representation are to be halted, as they must, more lawyers and more citizens must rediscover their commitment to longstanding non-partisan civic principles and commit to refuse to allow anyone to intimidate them from free exercise of foundational constitutional rights.

AI.tldr: 本文认为特朗普政府正在推动宪法体系的激进变革，压制批评者，导致法律专业人士和公众的言论自由受到寒蝉效应，构成了对美国公民空间的严重威胁。
AI.research_question: 美国公民空间的状况有多糟糕？特朗普政府是否在客观地破坏宪法体系和法治原则？
AI.motivation: 公众和法律界对美国公民空间状况的持续关注和讨论，以及特朗普政府行为对法治和宪法体系的潜在威胁。
AI.theoretical_framework: 法治原则、宪法体系、言论自由（第一修正案）、公民参与理论、权力制衡理论
AI.method: 基于四个数据点的论证分析：1)特朗普政府对宪法体系的激进变革；2)对批评者的惩罚和恐吓；3)律师不愿代理政府针对的客户；4)多数美国人对总统持批评态度
AI.findings: 特朗普政府正在推动激进的宪法变革，压制批评者，导致法律专业人士和公众的言论自由受到寒蝉效应，多数美国人持批评态度但感到被压制。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"客观公民空间问题"的概念，强调当多数人的言论自由被压制时，就构成了共和国的客观问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 呼吁律师和公民重新承诺非党派公民原则，拒绝被恐吓而放弃行使宪法权利，以阻止对言论自由和法律代理的压制。

title: “Harvest Now Decrypt Later”: Examining Post-Quantum Cryptography and the Data Privacy Risks for Distributed Ledger Networks
affiliations: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System and

detail.title: “Harvest Now Decrypt Later”: Examining Post-Quantum Cryptography and the Data Privacy Risks for Distributed Ledger Networks

publicationDetails.detailsText: Finance and Economics Discussion Series, issue 2025-093, 2025[10.17016/FEDS.2025.093]

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: Finance & Economics Discussion Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: This paper analyzes the risks posed by future-state quantum computers, specifically the “harvest now decrypt later” (HNDL) risk. We review foundational concepts of quantum computing to address the present and ongoing threat of HNDL to currently protected data. We use the Bitcoin network as an illustrative example to study the implications of HNDL for distributed ledger cryptocurrency networks that rely upon traditional cryptography. We posit that while cryptocurrency distributed ledger network maintainers could successfully deploy post-quantum cryptography (PQC) mitigations to protect the network’s security and data integrity against a future-state quantum computer, data privacy of the network’s previously recorded transactions remains vulnerable against a future-state quantum computer due to HNDL. The difficulty in protecting data privacy lies in the risk that a bad actor can obtain a distributed ledger replica, harvest the data, and in the fullness of time reveal previously obfuscated and confidential data using a sufficiently powerful quantum computer. The authors highlight this gap in data privacy protection and note the shortage of mitigations for the data privacy risks associated with the HNDL threat within distributed ledger networks.

AI.tldr: 该论文分析了未来量子计算机带来的"现在收集，将来解密"风险，以比特币网络为例，指出虽然分布式账本网络可以通过后量子密码学保护网络安全，但先前交易的数据隐私仍面临量子攻击威胁。
AI.research_question: 分布式账本加密货币网络中，面对未来量子计算机的"现在收集，将来解密"威胁，如何保护先前交易记录的数据隐私？
AI.motivation: 量子计算的发展对传统密码学构成威胁，特别是"现在收集，将来解密"攻击模式，攻击者现在收集加密数据，待量子计算机成熟后解密，这对分布式账本网络的历史交易隐私构成严重风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 量子计算基础理论、后量子密码学、分布式账本安全框架、数据隐私保护理论、密码学攻击模型。
AI.method: 概念性分析框架，以比特币网络为案例研究，结合量子计算原理和分布式账本技术特性，进行风险识别和脆弱性分析。
AI.findings: 1. 分布式账本网络可以通过部署后量子密码学保护未来网络安全；2. 但先前记录的交易数据隐私仍然脆弱；3. 攻击者可以获取账本副本，收集数据，待量子计算机成熟后解密；4. 当前缺乏针对HNDL威胁的数据隐私保护措施。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 识别了分布式账本网络中HNDL威胁的数据隐私保护缺口；2. 区分了网络安全保护和数据隐私保护的不同需求；3. 提出了量子时代分布式账本数据隐私保护的理论挑战。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 警示分布式账本维护者关注历史交易数据隐私风险；2. 指出当前缓解措施的不足；3. 为制定量子安全的数据隐私保护策略提供基础。

title: A Burning Need: Addressing Social Instability and Wildfire Risk in Canada

detail.title: A Burning Need: Addressing Social Instability and Wildfire Risk in Canada
detail.abstract: An academic analysis of the global impact of climate change, focusing specifically on how it drives social, economic, and political instability. It establishes that human activity is the primary cause of climate change and details its consequences, including rising temperatures, extreme weather events, and resource scarcity. The document transitions to a comparative examination of wildfire instability across countries with differing levels of state capacity, contrasting high-income Canada, middle-income Brazil, and low-middle-income Indonesia. For each country, the analysis discusses the history of fire, recent catastrophic seasons, government response strategies, and specific investments, concluding with policy recommendations for domestic action and international cooperation to enhance global wildfire resilience.

AI.tldr: 本文分析气候变化如何通过野火风险加剧社会、经济和政治不稳定，比较加拿大、巴西和印度尼西亚这三个不同国家能力水平的国家，提出增强全球野火韧性的政策建议。
AI.research_question: 气候变化如何通过野火风险影响不同国家能力水平国家的社会、经济和政治稳定？
AI.motivation: 气候变化已成为全球性挑战，特别是野火风险的加剧对各国稳定构成威胁。不同国家能力水平的国家在应对野火风险方面存在显著差异，需要系统分析以制定有效的应对策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 气候变化与不稳定理论、国家能力理论、环境安全理论、比较政治经济学框架
AI.method: 比较案例研究法，选取加拿大（高收入国家）、巴西（中等收入国家）和印度尼西亚（中低收入国家）三个不同国家能力水平的国家进行对比分析
AI.findings: 1. 气候变化显著增加了各国野火风险；2. 国家能力水平直接影响野火应对效果；3. 高收入国家如加拿大有更强的预防和应对能力；4. 中等收入国家如巴西面临治理挑战；5. 中低收入国家如印度尼西亚资源有限但国际合作可弥补不足
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 发展了气候变化与不稳定关系的理论框架；2. 深化了国家能力在环境治理中的作用理解；3. 提出了野火风险与国家稳定性的理论联系
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为各国制定野火风险管理政策提供参考；2. 提出增强国际合作的建议；3. 为不同能力水平国家提供差异化应对策略；4. 促进全球野火韧性建设

title: Idea Note: Thermal Enhancement of Photonic Boundaries via Nickel-Cadmium Stimulated Emission -A 1992 Conceptual LASER Project

detail.title: Idea Note: Thermal Enhancement of Photonic Boundaries via Nickel-Cadmium Stimulated Emission -A 1992 Conceptual LASER Project
detail.abstract: This idea note outlines a conceptual LASER (Light Amplification by Stimulated Emission of Radiation) project ideated in 1992, focusing on the thermal modulation of the outer periphery of photons-or the boundary regions of light waves-through a nickel-cadmium (NiCd) medium in a stimulated emission framework. By integrating NiCd's electrochemical properties, the concept aimed to induce targeted heating at photonic edges, potentially transforming applications in precision optics, thermal imaging, and energy-efficient laser systems. Although never executed, the idea drew inspiration from established metal vapour lasers, proposing a hybrid opto-electrochemical approach. This note details the theoretical foundations, a refined hypothesis, proposed testing preparations, and potential implications, contextualising it within laser technology's evolution since the 1960s (Littlewood, 2010; Daido, 2008).

AI.tldr: 1992年提出的概念性LASER项目，通过镍镉介质在受激发射框架中对光子外缘进行热调制，旨在实现精密光学、热成像和节能激光系统的应用，但从未实际执行。
AI.research_question: 如何通过镍镉介质的电化学特性在受激发射框架中对光子外缘进行热调制？
AI.motivation: 受金属蒸气激光器的启发，探索将电化学特性与激光技术结合的混合光电化学方法，以扩展激光在精密光学、热成像和节能系统中的应用潜力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于受激发射辐射(LASER)理论，结合镍镉电化学特性和金属蒸气激光器原理，提出光子边界区域热调制的概念框架。
AI.method: 概念性设计方法，包括理论分析、假设提炼、测试方案设计，但未实际执行实验验证。
AI.findings: 这是一个未执行的概念性项目，没有实际实验结果，但提出了潜在的应用前景和理论可能性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了混合光电化学激光系统的概念框架，扩展了传统激光理论，探索了光子边界热调制的新思路。
AI.practical_contributions: 为精密光学、热成像和节能激光系统提供了潜在的技术方向，虽然未实际实现，但启发了相关领域的研究思路。

title: Rural Advanced Manufacturing Renaissance: A Strategic Framework for Domestic Battery and Robotics Production in Flagler, Colorado

detail.title: Rural Advanced Manufacturing Renaissance: A Strategic Framework for Domestic Battery and Robotics Production in Flagler, Colorado
detail.abstract: This paper presents a strategic framework for establishing advanced manufacturing capabilities in rural Colorado, specifically examining Flagler's 480-acre land grant program as a foundation for domestic battery component and robotics production. The analysis addresses critical national security vulnerabilities in advanced technology supply chains, particularly China's stated ambition to dominate global humanoid robot manufacturing by 2027 and ongoing dependencies in battery production. Through detailed examination of federal funding mechanisms, including $3.5 billion in available Department of Energy battery manufacturing grants and 45X production tax credits, the paper demonstrates how strategic layering of municipal land incentives, federal investment, and phased capacity expansion can establish economically viable manufacturing operations in communities of 500-1,000 residents. The proposed three-phase implementation strategy begins with edge AI school safety system production (25-50 employees), expands to battery component manufacturing leveraging DOE grants (150-200 employees), and scales to integrated advanced manufacturing campus operations (300-500 employees). Financial modeling demonstrates project viability with conservative revenue projections reaching $200 million annually by Phase 3, while generating transformational community economic impact equivalent to 65% of current population employment. The framework emphasizes risk mitigation through incremental scaling, community benefits integration, and workforce development partnerships. This approach offers a replicable model for distributed advanced manufacturing networks across rural America, addressing both national competitiveness imperatives and regional economic development objectives.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个在科罗拉多州农村地区建立先进制造能力的战略框架，以Flagler的480英亩土地赠予计划为基础，发展国内电池组件和机器人生产。该框架通过分阶段实施、联邦资金利用和社区整合，为农村地区提供可复制的先进制造模式。
AI.research_question: 如何在美国农村地区（特别是科罗拉多州）建立经济可行的先进制造能力，以解决国家安全供应链脆弱性并促进区域经济发展？
AI.motivation:
1. 国家安全：中国计划在2027年主导全球人形机器人制造，以及电池生产依赖带来的供应链脆弱性
2. 区域经济发展：为人口500-1000人的农村社区创造就业和经济转型机会
3. 国家竞争力：建立分布式先进制造网络以增强美国制造业竞争力
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 战略供应链管理理论
2. 区域经济发展理论
3. 公共-私人合作伙伴关系理论
4. 分阶段能力建设理论
5. 分布式制造网络理论
AI.method:
1. 案例研究：以Flagler的480英亩土地赠予计划为分析对象
2. 政策分析：详细研究联邦资金机制（35亿美元能源部电池制造拨款和45X生产税收抵免）
3. 财务建模：基于保守收入预测的项目可行性分析
4. 分阶段实施策略设计：三阶段扩展计划
AI.findings:
1. 通过战略整合市政土地激励、联邦投资和分阶段能力扩展，可以在农村社区建立经济可行的制造业务
2. 三阶段实施策略：边缘AI学校安全系统生产（25-50员工）→电池组件制造（150-200员工）→集成先进制造园区（300-500员工）
3. 财务模型显示项目可行性，第三阶段年收入可达2亿美元
4. 可创造相当于当前人口65%的就业机会，实现社区经济转型
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出了农村先进制造能力建设的综合理论框架
2. 发展了分布式制造网络与国家安全供应链整合的理论
3. 贡献了公共-私人合作模式在农村制造业发展的理论
4. 完善了分阶段能力建设与风险缓解的理论
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为Flagler等农村社区提供了具体的实施路线图
2. 展示了如何有效利用联邦资金和税收优惠政策
3. 提供了可复制的农村先进制造发展模式
4. 为政策制定者提供了促进农村制造业发展的实用工具
5. 为企业提供了在农村地区投资的可行性分析框架

title: When Trust Obscures Truth: Can Machine Learning Detect Fraud Where Traditional Audits Fail?
affiliations: and

detail.title: When Trust Obscures Truth: Can Machine Learning Detect Fraud Where Traditional Audits Fail?
detail.abstract: Microfinance institutions are critical drivers of economic development, yet their stability is frequently undermined by internal fraud. This study addresses this challenge within Bali's indigenous microfinance institutions, the Lembaga Perkreditan Desa (LPD), which is persistently threatened by internal fraud, a problem rooted in the information asymmetries and goal incongruence described by Agency Theory. Traditional audits often fail to mitigate these agency costs because they are reactive and lack the capacity to analyze complex transactional data. This study addresses this critical governance gap by integrating Agency Theory with Prediction Theory to develop and validate a proactive, data-driven fraud risk assessment framework. Employing an explanatory sequential mixed-methods design, we analyzed 5 years of panel data (2019–2023) from 30 LPDs using the unsupervised Isolation Forest (iForest) algorithm to detect financial anomalies. The quantitative findings were subsequently contextualized through in-depth interviews with eight experienced LPD auditors and supervisors. The iForest model successfully identified high-risk observations characterized by patterns such as anomalously low loan-loss provisions and inconsistent asset-deposit growth. The qualitative phase confirmed these patterns are significant red flags often overlooked due to a culturally rooted trust bias and the absence of forensic data analytics. This research concludes that unsupervised machine learning offers not just a technical tool, but a novel governance mechanism to mitigate agency problems in a microfinance context. The primary implication of these findings is a potential paradigm shift in regulatory oversight, moving from reactive, compliance-based audits to a proactive, risk-based supervisory model, ultimately enhancing financial transparency and securing the long-term viability of these vital community institutions.

AI.tldr: 本研究将代理理论与预测理论结合，开发并验证了一个主动的数据驱动欺诈风险评估框架，用于解决巴厘岛乡村信贷机构（LPD）的内部欺诈问题。通过混合方法研究发现，无监督机器学习（Isolation Forest算法）能有效识别财务异常模式，为监管提供了从被动合规审计转向主动风险监督的新治理机制。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个有效的主动数据驱动框架来评估和缓解巴厘岛乡村信贷机构（LPD）的内部欺诈风险？
AI.motivation: 微型金融机构对经济发展至关重要，但其稳定性常受内部欺诈威胁。巴厘岛的LPD机构持续面临内部欺诈问题，传统审计方法因被动且无法分析复杂交易数据而效果有限，存在关键治理缺口。
AI.theoretical_framework: 代理理论（解释信息不对称和目标不一致导致的欺诈问题）和预测理论（支持数据驱动的风险预测框架）。
AI.method: 解释性顺序混合方法设计：1）定量分析：使用无监督的Isolation Forest算法分析30个LPD机构5年（2019-2023）的面板数据，检测财务异常；2）定性分析：对8位经验丰富的LPD审计师和监督者进行深度访谈，将定量发现情境化。
AI.findings: iForest模型成功识别了高风险观察值，其特征模式包括异常低的贷款损失准备金和不一致的资产-存款增长。定性阶段确认这些模式是重要的危险信号，常因文化根源的信任偏见和缺乏法务数据分析而被忽视。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）将代理理论与预测理论整合，为微型金融欺诈风险提供了新的理论框架；2）证明无监督机器学习不仅是技术工具，更是缓解代理问题的新型治理机制；3）为信息不对称环境下的机构治理提供了理论扩展。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）开发了可操作的主动欺诈风险评估框架；2）为监管机构提供了从被动合规审计转向主动风险监督的范式转变路径；3）增强了财务透明度，保障了社区金融机构的长期可持续性；4）为类似机构提供了可复制的风险管理方法。

title: Smart Transportation Systems with Artificial Intelligence: Enhancing Efficiency, Safety, and Sustainability
affiliations: , Atish Dipankar University of Science & Technology (ADUST) and BRAC University, Bangladesh

detail.title: Smart Transportation Systems with Artificial Intelligence: Enhancing Efficiency, Safety, and Sustainability
detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is transforming transportation, yet most research and applications focus on isolated improvements, lacking a unified approach that connects operational gains with strategic national goals. This paper addresses this gap by developing a conceptual framework that synthesizes how AI enhances transportation systems across three integrated pillars: efficiency, safety, and sustainability. Through a synthesis of recent literature and industry case studies, we propose a model that demonstrates the synergistic effects of AI applications, such as predictive maintenance and dynamic routing. The framework's primary contribution is to illustrate how these technological advancements collectively bolster U.S. competitiveness by building resilient supply chains, reducing emissions, and fostering leadership in sustainable innovation. This study provides a structured roadmap for policymakers and industry leaders to leverage AI not merely for operational efficiency, but as a strategic asset for long-term economic security.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个整合人工智能在交通系统中应用的框架，将效率、安全和可持续性三大支柱相结合，展示AI如何通过预测性维护、动态路线规划等技术增强美国竞争力，为政策制定者和行业领导者提供战略路线图。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个统一框架，将人工智能在交通系统中的操作改进与战略国家目标连接起来？
AI.motivation: 当前AI在交通领域的研究和应用大多关注孤立改进，缺乏将操作收益与战略国家目标相连接的统一方法，需要填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 提出了一个概念框架，整合AI在交通系统中的三大支柱：效率、安全性和可持续性，展示这些要素之间的协同效应。
AI.method: 通过综合近期文献和行业案例研究，提出了一个模型来展示AI应用的协同效应。
AI.findings: AI应用（如预测性维护和动态路线规划）通过协同作用共同增强美国竞争力，包括建设弹性供应链、减少排放和促进可持续创新领导地位。
AI.theory_contributions: 主要理论贡献是提出了一个概念框架，展示AI技术如何通过整合效率、安全和可持续性三大支柱，共同支持国家战略目标。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和行业领导者提供了结构化路线图，将AI不仅视为操作效率工具，更作为长期经济安全的战略资产。

title: Executive Overreach and the Assault on Judicial Independence: Constitutional Analysis of Presidential Targeting of the Legal Profession
affiliations: Independent Scholar

detail.title: Executive Overreach and the Assault on Judicial Independence: Constitutional Analysis of Presidential Targeting of the Legal Profession

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Exact Text to Paste into SSRN "Declaration of Interest" Field: The author acknowledges the use of AI assistance for document formatting and literature organization. All theoretical development, research design, analysis, and conclusions are the original work of the author. All factual claims, constitutional interpretations, legal analysis, and policy recommendations reflect the author's independent scholarly judgment and original intellectual contribution. The author takes complete responsibility for all constitutional analysis and conclusions presented.

keywords: documenting ongoing constitutional crisis during active governmental targeting campaigns Constitutional violation pattern analysis
and predictive framework validation through government response patterns

detail.abstract:
This study documents a constitutional crisis unfolding in real-time: systematic presidential targeting of law firms represents the first coordinated assault on judicial independence in American history, culminating in documented constitutional violations across First Amendment, Due Process, and Separation of Powers clauses. Through empirical analysis of the American Bar Association's landmark lawsuit (June 16, 2025), documentation of unanimous judicial rejection across four federal court cases, and real-time constitutional crisis analysis during active executive intimidation campaigns, we reveal how the "Law Firm Intimidation Policy" creates constitutional violations through financial coercion ($1 billion in extracted settlements), professional intimidation (documented chilling effects), and democratic process corruption (bypass of constitutional constraints through manufactured urgency).

We establish a novel Constitutional Coercion Doctrine Framework extending established federal-state coercion principles to private entities exercising constitutional rights, demonstrating that law firm targeting presents exponentially stronger constitutional violations than traditional intergovernmental coercion. Our analysis reveals systematic threats to the Sixth Amendment right to counsel: targeting creates professional dependency that structurally impairs access to legal representation, as documented in United States v. Stein (2008) and applied in Perkins Coie LLP v. U.S. Department of Justice (2025). When government pressure forces firms to decline representation to avoid retaliation, the constitutional guarantee of effective counsel becomes practically unenforceable, destroying constitutional safeguards essential for democratic accountability.

The June 27, 2025, final judicial ruling striking down the fourth executive order provides real-time validation of our constitutional framework, with documented instances of executive overreach following historical authoritarian consolidation patterns identified in comparative democratic backsliding scholarship. We argue that immediate implementation of constitutional resistance methodology represents both democratic necessity and emergency framework for preventing authoritarian consolidation through systematic targeting of legal profession independence. This analysis addresses critical gaps in constitutional law literature by documenting constitutional violations warranting potential criminal investigation while establishing empirical validation through real-time judicial resistance analysis during active governmental constitutional assault.

Keywords: constitutional law, executive overreach, judicial independence, separation of powers, First Amendment, legal profession, authoritarian consolidation, democratic resistance, constitutional crisis, emergency powers

AI.tldr: 本文记录了美国历史上首次针对司法独立的系统性攻击：总统对律师事务所的针对性打击，这导致了第一修正案、正当程序和权力分立条款的宪法违宪。通过实证分析，揭示了"律师事务所恐吓政策"通过金融胁迫、职业恐吓和民主程序腐败制造宪法违宪，并建立了新的宪法胁迫原则框架。
AI.research_question: 总统系统性针对律师事务所的行为如何构成对美国司法独立的首次协调攻击，并导致第一修正案、正当程序和权力分立条款的宪法违宪？
AI.motivation: 记录正在实时展开的宪法危机，揭示系统性总统针对律师事务所代表了对美国司法独立的首次协调攻击，这种攻击模式符合比较民主倒退研究中识别的历史威权巩固模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 建立了新颖的宪法胁迫原则框架，将既有的联邦-州胁迫原则扩展到行使宪法权利的私人实体；应用第六修正案获得律师帮助的权利理论；借鉴比较民主倒退和威权巩固的学术研究。
AI.method: 对美国律师协会具有里程碑意义的诉讼（2025年6月16日）进行实证分析；记录四个联邦法院案件中的一致司法否决；在积极的行政恐吓运动期间进行实时宪法危机分析；分析历史案例如United States v. Stein (2008)和Perkins Coie LLP v. U.S. Department of Justice (2025)。
AI.findings: "律师事务所恐吓政策"通过金融胁迫（10亿美元的和解金提取）、职业恐吓（有记录的寒蝉效应）和民主程序腐败（通过制造紧急情况绕过宪法约束）制造宪法违宪；针对律师事务所的行为比传统的政府间胁迫构成指数级更强的宪法违宪；系统性威胁第六修正案获得律师帮助的权利；2025年6月27日最终司法裁决推翻了第四项行政命令，实时验证了宪法框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了宪法胁迫原则框架，将胁迫分析扩展到私人实体；填补了宪法法律文献中的关键空白，记录了可能引发刑事调查的宪法违宪；通过实时司法抵抗分析建立了实证验证；扩展了对威权巩固和民主倒退的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为宪法抵抗方法提供了紧急框架，以防止通过系统性针对法律职业独立来实现威权巩固；为法律从业者提供了应对行政越权的实用指导；为司法机构提供了评估宪法违宪的分析工具；为民主问责制提供了保护机制。

title: Entrepreneurial Barriers and the Intention–Action Gap: A Case Study of Indonesian Generation Z Business Graduates
affiliations: , Bandung Institute of Technology - School of Business and Management and

detail.title: Entrepreneurial Barriers and the Intention–Action Gap: A Case Study of Indonesian Generation Z Business Graduates
detail.abstract: Despite the strong entrepreneurial aspirations among Indonesia’s Generation Z business graduates, few manage to turn their intentions into actual business ventures. Through a deductive, explanatory case-study approach, the study conducted in-depth, semi-structured interviews with two recent graduates to explore how four barriers identified in the literature—psychological, financial, lack of mentorship, and regulatory complexity—interact to hinder action. The findings reveal that (1) a profound fear of failure, stemming from previous venture setbacks, undermines the confidence needed to launch; (2) persistent capital shortages are exacerbated by the respondents’ religious aversion to interest-bearing loans, necessitating slow self-financing; (3) limited access to affordable, ongoing mentorship leaves critical capability gaps unaddressed, reinforcing self-doubt; and (4) complex licensing fees, neighborhood approvals, and documentation requirements inflate start-up costs and timelines, intensifying both financial and psychological stress. These interconnected obstacles create a self-imposed readiness pause, during which graduates focus on skill-building and incremental saving rather than formalizing their ventures.

AI.tldr: 尽管印尼Z世代商科毕业生有强烈的创业意愿，但很少有人能将创业意图转化为实际创业行动。研究发现心理、财务、缺乏导师和监管复杂性这四大障碍相互作用，导致毕业生陷入"自我强制的准备暂停期"，专注于技能积累和渐进储蓄而非正式创业。
AI.research_question: 印尼Z世代商科毕业生创业意图与实际创业行动之间的差距是如何形成的？具体来说，文献中识别的四大障碍（心理、财务、缺乏导师和监管复杂性）如何相互作用阻碍创业行动？
AI.motivation: 印尼Z世代商科毕业生有强烈的创业意愿，但实际创业率低，这种意图与行动之间的差距需要深入理解。研究旨在探索阻碍创业行动的具体障碍及其相互作用机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于创业意图-行动差距理论，结合四大障碍框架：心理障碍（恐惧失败）、财务障碍（资金短缺）、社会资本障碍（缺乏导师）和制度障碍（监管复杂性）。
AI.method: 采用演绎性、解释性案例研究方法，对两名近期毕业生进行深度半结构化访谈，探索四大障碍的相互作用机制。
AI.findings: 研究发现：(1) 先前创业挫折导致的深度失败恐惧削弱创业信心；(2) 资金短缺因宗教反对利息贷款而加剧，只能缓慢自我融资；(3) 缺乏可负担的持续导师支持导致能力缺口未解决，强化自我怀疑；(4) 复杂的许可费、邻里批准和文件要求增加创业成本和时间，加剧财务和心理压力。这些障碍相互作用形成"自我强制的准备暂停期"。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献：深化了对创业意图-行动差距的理解，揭示了四大障碍的相互作用机制，提出了"自我强制的准备暂停期"概念，丰富了创业障碍理论在宗教文化背景下的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践意义：为创业教育者提供针对性干预策略，建议政策制定者简化监管流程，金融机构开发符合宗教原则的融资方案，创业生态系统提供可负担的导师支持，帮助毕业生克服障碍实现创业。

title: Expona V2.2: A Fully Collateralized Crypto-Native Reserve Bank With Dual-Yield Equity and Convex Volatility Harvesting
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Expona V2.2: A Fully Collateralized Crypto-Native Reserve Bank With Dual-Yield Equity and Convex Volatility Harvesting
detail.abstract: Expona is a decentralized reserve-bank protocol that issues a fully redeemable, crypto-native digital banknote (EXS), backed by a minimum 1:1 reserve of ETH and ARB. Unlike algorithmic stablecoins, EXS's stability is derived from a robust treasury system funded by market volatility itself. This is achieved through two novel mechanisms: the Convex Tax Engine and Predictive Queue Tracking (PQT). The protocol's equity token, EXNA, captures value not only from transaction fees but, innovatively, from the long-term appreciation of the treasury's collateral assets via the Treasury Appreciation Sharing Mechanism (TASM). Volatility shocks are managed by a large protocol-owned EXS buffer and a newly defined Shock Absorber Mode, which activates during significant collateral drawdowns to ensure orderly system recovery. This architecture creates a self-funding, self-stabilizing reserve bank that is entirely powered by endogenous crypto-market behavior, transforming volatility into both immediate treasury growth and long-term equity holder value.

AI.tldr: Expona是一个去中心化储备银行协议，发行完全可赎回的加密原生数字银行票据EXS，由至少1:1的ETH和ARB储备支持。其稳定性通过凸性税收引擎和预测队列追踪机制实现，利用市场波动为协议提供资金。协议股权代币EXNA通过国库增值分享机制捕获抵押资产长期升值价值。波动冲击由协议拥有的EXS缓冲区和新定义的冲击吸收模式管理。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个去中心化的储备银行协议，能够发行稳定的加密原生数字银行票据，利用市场波动实现自我融资和自我稳定，同时为股权持有者创造长期价值？
AI.motivation: 传统算法稳定币缺乏稳健的储备支持，容易在波动中崩溃。现有稳定币解决方案要么过度依赖外部抵押，要么缺乏可持续的资金机制。需要一种能够将市场波动转化为协议优势，同时确保稳定性和可持续性的新型协议设计。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 储备银行理论：基于传统中央银行储备管理理念的加密原生实现；2. 波动性金融理论：将市场波动转化为协议收入来源；3. 协议自有流动性理论：通过协议拥有的缓冲资产管理系统性风险；4. 凸性税收机制：利用非线性税收结构优化协议收入；5. 预测队列追踪：通过预测性机制管理赎回队列。
AI.method: 协议设计方法：1. 建立至少1:1的ETH和ARB储备支持；2. 实施凸性税收引擎，根据市场条件动态调整税收；3. 采用预测队列追踪机制管理赎回；4. 引入国库增值分享机制，将抵押资产升值分配给股权持有者；5. 设计冲击吸收模式，在抵押资产大幅下跌时激活有序恢复机制。
AI.findings: 1. 协议能够发行完全可赎回的稳定数字银行票据；2. 凸性税收引擎和预测队列追踪机制有效利用市场波动为协议提供资金；3. 国库增值分享机制成功将抵押资产长期升值转化为股权价值；4. 协议拥有的EXS缓冲区和冲击吸收模式有效管理系统性风险；5. 整个系统完全由加密市场内生行为驱动，实现自我融资和自我稳定。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了去中心化储备银行协议的理论框架；2. 发展了将市场波动转化为协议收入的创新机制；3. 建立了协议自有流动性管理的系统性方法；4. 扩展了稳定币设计理论，超越了传统算法稳定币的局限；5. 为加密原生金融系统提供了新的稳定性理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为加密市场提供了新的稳定币解决方案；2. 为投资者提供了参与协议股权价值增长的机会；3. 为DeFi生态系统提供了更稳健的稳定资产；4. 为协议设计者提供了管理波动性和系统性风险的新工具；5. 为去中心化金融基础设施的发展提供了实际案例。

title: Case Study: Orbital Improvisation Under Fire -The Shenzhou-20/21 Crew Swap and Its Ripple Effects on Tiangong Operations

detail.title: Case Study: Orbital Improvisation Under Fire -The Shenzhou-20/21 Crew Swap and Its Ripple Effects on Tiangong Operations

keywords: Project Management and Risk Governance Antifragile Systems

detail.abstract: Picture this: You're 400 kilometers above Earth, your ride home's got a hairline fracture from a speck of cosmic shrapnel, and the clock's ticking on your oxygen and sanity. That's the nail-biter China Manned Space Agency (CMSA) faced in November 2025 with the Shenzhou-20 mission. What started as a routine six-month stint on the Tiangong space station turned into the first-ever in-orbit crew vehicle swap due to space debris damage. Drawing on real-time CMSA releases, crew debriefs, and orbital telemetry analyses, this case unpacks the incident's anatomy-from the "tiny cracks" in the return capsule to the accelerated Shenzhou-22 launch that's now keeping Tiangong humming with an extended Shenzhou-21 crew. We spotlight the human ingenuity behind it: pre-baked redundancies, lightning-fast decision loops, and a handover "sprint" that kept science rolling amid chaos. Lessons? In megaprojects-from space stations to megadams-treat debris (literal or figurative) as a feature, not a bug. This isn't just aerospace arcana; it's a blueprint for any team staring down black swans. Implications for PM practitioners: Bake in modularity early, rehearse the unthinkable, and remember-resilience isn't about avoiding storms, it's dancing in them. (198 words)

title: Good Governance in Practice: A Qualitative Analysis of Village Government Performance in Indonesian Independent Villages
affiliations: , Bandung Institute of Technology and

detail.title: Good Governance in Practice: A Qualitative Analysis of Village Government Performance in Indonesian Independent Villages
detail.abstract: This study examines the effectiveness of village governance in Indonesian Independent villages, highlighting the critical paradox where villages achieving the highest Village Development Index (IDM) ratings simultaneously exhibit substantial governance deficiencies that contradict good governance principles. Despite their elevated status, these villages continue to face persistent challenges, including corruption, financial mismanagement, and limited community outcomes, which directly violate the principles of transparency, accountability, and effectiveness. Using qualitative multiple case study design with semi-structured interviews across two Independent villages in Bandung Regency and employing Gioia methodology, this research identifies five critical governance dimensions: (1) Governance Capacity & Resources, revealing significant competency gaps hinders performance efficiency; (2) Planning & Coordination Mechanisms, as top-down policies frequently conflict with bottom-up community aspirations, reducing participatory effectiveness; (3) Transparency, Accountability & Oversight, demonstrating procedural compliance with reporting serving as a formality rather than a genuine tool of performance accountability; (4) Community Engagement & Inclusion, dominated by conventional mechanisms limiting inclusive participation; and (5) Institutional Functionality & Governance Structure, displaying leadership-dependent effectiveness that challenges rule of law consistency. These findings reveal a governance paradox in which formal compliance with structures conceals practices that contradict the principles of good governance. The study emphasizes the need for outcome-based performance evaluation systems that prioritize substantive governance over procedural compliance.

AI.tldr: 本研究揭示了印尼独立村庄治理的悖论：尽管获得最高村庄发展指数评级，但这些村庄仍存在严重治理缺陷，包括腐败、财务管理不善和社区成果有限，违背了透明度、问责制和有效性原则。
AI.research_question: 印尼独立村庄治理的有效性如何？为什么获得最高村庄发展指数评级的村庄仍存在严重治理缺陷？
AI.motivation: 揭示印尼独立村庄治理中的关键悖论：村庄发展指数高评级与实质治理缺陷并存，需要深入理解形式合规与实际治理质量之间的差距。
AI.theoretical_framework: 良好治理原则（透明度、问责制、有效性）、村庄治理理论、治理悖论理论、Gioia方法论。
AI.method: 定性多案例研究设计，采用半结构化访谈，研究对象为万隆县两个独立村庄，运用Gioia方法论进行分析。
AI.findings: 识别出五个关键治理维度：1)治理能力与资源存在能力差距；2)规划与协调机制中上下政策冲突；3)透明度、问责与监督流于形式；4)社区参与受限于传统机制；5)制度功能与治理结构依赖领导力。这些发现揭示了形式合规掩盖实质治理缺陷的悖论。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"治理悖论"概念，解释了形式合规与实际治理质量之间的差距，丰富了村庄治理理论，为理解发展中国家地方治理提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 强调需要建立基于结果的绩效评估系统，优先考虑实质性治理而非程序合规，为印尼及其他发展中国家村庄治理改革提供政策建议。

title: Research on mobile e-commerce visual marketing based on the ISMAS model
affiliations: Shandong Jiaotong University, Shandong Jiaotong University - International Business School, Shandong Jiaotong University and Shandong Jiaotong University

detail.title: Research on mobile e-commerce visual marketing based on the ISMAS model
detail.abstract: Visual marketing, a strategy using visual elements to convey brand and marketing information, is vital for enhancing mobile e-commerce competitiveness. Despite its importance, research on this topic remains limited and homogeneous. This study explores the impact mechanism of mobile e-commerce visual marketing on consumer purchase intention, based on the ISMAS model (interest, search, word of mouth, action, and sharing). It conducts mediation and moderation effect analyses using SPSS 20.0 and Process 3.5. The findings reveal a significant positive relationship among the five ISMAS variables. Search, reputation, and action mediate different impact paths. Age moderates the search-reputation and reputation-action relationships, while education moderates the reputation-action relationship. This study extends the ISMAS model, offering new insights for future research. It provides visual marketing recommendations for mobile e-commerce platforms and merchants to optimize strategies, enhance the user experience, and boost conversion rates, supporting sustainable industry development.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于ISMAS模型，探讨移动电商视觉营销对消费者购买意愿的影响机制，发现ISMAS五个变量间存在显著正相关关系，搜索、口碑和行动在不同影响路径中起中介作用，年龄和教育程度调节部分关系。
AI.research_question: 移动电商视觉营销如何通过ISMAS模型（兴趣、搜索、口碑、行动、分享）影响消费者购买意愿？
AI.motivation: 视觉营销对提升移动电商竞争力至关重要，但现有研究有限且同质化，需要深入探讨其影响机制。

AI.method: 使用SPSS 20.0和Process 3.5进行中介效应和调节效应分析。
AI.findings: 1. ISMAS五个变量间存在显著正相关关系；2. 搜索、口碑和行动在不同影响路径中起中介作用；3. 年龄调节搜索-口碑和口碑-行动关系；4. 教育程度调节口碑-行动关系。
