AI.practical_contributions: 为移动电商平台和商家提供视觉营销建议，优化策略、提升用户体验、提高转化率，支持行业可持续发展。

title: Epistemological Fault Lines between Human and Artificial Intelligence
affiliations: University of Rome Sapienza, Università degli Studi di Milano-Bicocca - Department of Psychology and Faculty of Natural Sciences and Mathematics, University of Maribor

detail.title: Epistemological Fault Lines between Human and Artificial Intelligence
detail.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are widely described as artificial intelligence, yet their epistemic profile diverges sharply from human cognition. Here we show that the apparent alignment between human and machine outputs conceals a deeper structural mismatch in how judgments are produced. Tracing the historical shift from symbolic AI and information filtering systems to large-scale generative transformers, we argue that LLMs are not epistemic agents but stochastic pattern-completion systems, formally describable as walks on high-dimensional graphs of linguistic transitions rather than as systems that form beliefs or models of the world. By systematically mapping human and artificial epistemic pipelines, we identify seven epistemic fault lines, divergences in grounding, parsing, experience, motivation, causal reasoning, metacognition, and value. We call the resulting condition Epistemia: a structural situation in which linguistic plausibility substitutes for epistemic evaluation, producing the feeling of knowing without the labor of judgment. We conclude by outlining consequences for evaluation, governance, and epistemic literacy in societies increasingly organized around generative AI.

AI.tldr: 该论文认为大型语言模型(LLMs)并非真正的认知主体，而是随机模式完成系统，其表面与人类输出的对齐掩盖了深层的认知结构不匹配。作者提出了"Epistemia"概念，即语言合理性替代认知评估的结构性情境。
AI.research_question: 大型语言模型作为人工智能系统，其认知结构与人类认知的根本差异是什么？这些差异如何影响我们对AI作为认知主体的理解？
AI.motivation: 尽管LLMs被广泛描述为人工智能，但其认知特征与人类认知存在显著差异。需要揭示表面输出对齐背后的深层结构不匹配，以正确理解LLMs的本质和局限性。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 从符号AI和信息过滤系统到大规模生成式transformer的历史转变
2. LLMs作为随机模式完成系统的形式化描述（高维语言转换图上的游走）
3. 认知管道映射和七个认知断层线理论
AI.method: 通过系统性地映射人类和人工认知管道，识别认知断层线。采用理论分析和概念框架构建的方法，而非实证研究。
AI.findings: 识别出七个认知断层线：基础、解析、经验、动机、因果推理、元认知和价值。提出了"Epistemia"概念，即语言合理性替代认知评估的结构性情境，产生"知道的感觉"而无判断的劳作。
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 将LLMs形式化为随机模式完成系统而非认知主体
2. 提出认知管道映射框架和七个认知断层线
3. 引入"Epistemia"概念来描述LLMs产生的认知情境
4. 挑战了LLMs作为真正认知主体的传统理解
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为LLMs评估提供新的理论框架
2. 对AI治理提出认知层面的考量
3. 促进生成式AI社会中认知素养的发展
4. 帮助决策者理解LLMs的认知局限性

title: Structured Event Representation and Stock Return Predictability
affiliations: The Chinese University of Hong Kong, CUHK Business School, National University of Singapore (NUS) and National University of Singapore (NUS)

detail.title: Structured Event Representation and Stock Return Predictability
detail.abstract: We find that event features extracted by large language models (LLMs) are effective for text-based stock return prediction. Using a pre-trained LLM to extract event features from news articles, we propose a novel deep learning model based on structured event representation (SER) and attention mechanisms to predict stock returns in the cross-section. Our SER-based model provides superior performance compared with other existing text-driven models to forecast stock returns out of sample and offers highly interpretable feature structures to examine the mechanisms underlying the stock return predictability. We further provide various implications based on SER and highlight the crucial benefit of structured model inputs in stock return predictability.

AI.tldr: LLM提取的事件特征能有效预测股票收益，基于结构化事件表示和注意力机制的深度学习模型优于现有文本驱动模型，并提供高度可解释的特征结构。
AI.research_question: 大型语言模型提取的事件特征如何用于基于文本的股票收益预测？
AI.motivation: 现有文本驱动模型在股票收益预测中存在局限性，需要更有效的文本特征提取方法和更可解释的预测模型。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构化事件表示理论、注意力机制、深度学习在金融预测中的应用
AI.method: 使用预训练LLM从新闻文章中提取事件特征，构建基于结构化事件表示和注意力机制的深度学习模型进行横截面股票收益预测
AI.findings: SER模型在样本外预测中优于现有文本驱动模型，提供高度可解释的特征结构，结构化模型输入对股票收益可预测性有重要益处
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于LLM事件特征提取的股票收益预测新框架，发展了结构化事件表示理论在金融预测中的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了更准确的股票收益预测工具，模型的可解释性有助于理解预测机制，结构化输入方法可推广到其他金融预测任务

title: Monetizing Platform Markets: Channel Structure and In-Game Advertiser Presence in Two-Sided Markets *
affiliations: University of Oklahoma - Department of Economics, University of Florida - Warrington College of Business Administration and Wuhan University

detail.title: Monetizing Platform Markets: Channel Structure and In-Game Advertiser Presence in Two-Sided Markets *
detail.abstract: Recent shifts in the video game console industry point to a growing reliance on ad-supported monetization models alongside traditional hardware and software sales. Major platform owners are exploring in-game advertising across consoles, mobile, and cloud environments, while hardware continues to be sold through physical retailers. This emerging configuration raises new strategic questions about how distribution channels and advertiser participation interact. Building on this industry context, this paper examines the strategic interplay between channel structure and the presence of advertisers in a two-sided market where one side consists of users and the other of advertisers. We compare outcomes under two channel structures-a platform selling directly to users or through a downstream retailer-and explore how the introduction of advertisers affects equilibrium outcomes across these structures. Conversely, we investigate how the platform's distribution channel affects equilibrium outcomes depending on whether the advertising side exists. Several interesting results emerge. In a one-sided market without advertisers, introducing a retailer consistently raises the retail price, reduces industry profit, and lowers social welfare due to double marginalization. However, in the presence of advertisers, while the introduction of a retailer still reduces industry profit, it can lower the retail price and increase social welfare. Similarly, when a retailer is already present, adding the advertiser side as a new source of revenue does not necessarily benefit the platform once the retailer's strategic response is accounted for. Our analysis reveals conditions under which advertiser presence and channel structure reinforce or counteract each other, offering new insights into platform design and multi-sided pricing strategies.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了视频游戏行业在广告支持模式兴起背景下，渠道结构与广告商参与之间的战略互动。研究发现，在单边市场（无广告商）中引入零售商会导致价格上涨、利润下降；但在有广告商的双边市场中，引入零售商反而可能降低价格、提高社会福利。
AI.research_question: 在视频游戏平台的双边市场中，渠道结构（直销vs零售商）与广告商参与如何相互影响均衡结果？
AI.motivation: 视频游戏行业正从传统的硬件/软件销售转向广告支持的盈利模式，平台所有者探索跨设备广告投放，同时硬件仍通过实体零售商销售。这种新兴配置提出了关于分销渠道与广告商参与如何互动的战略问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 双边市场理论、渠道管理理论、平台经济学、多边定价策略
AI.method: 理论建模分析，比较两种渠道结构（平台直销vs通过下游零售商销售）在不同市场配置（有/无广告商）下的均衡结果
AI.findings: 1. 在无广告商的单边市场中，引入零售商因双重边际化而提高零售价、降低行业利润和社会福利；2. 在有广告商的双边市场中，引入零售商仍降低行业利润，但可能降低零售价并提高社会福利；3. 已有零售商时，增加广告商作为新收入来源不一定使平台受益，需考虑零售商的战略反应
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了广告商存在与渠道结构之间的相互作用机制，为平台设计提供了新见解，扩展了双边市场和多边定价理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为视频游戏平台在广告支持模式下的渠道策略提供指导，帮助平台管理者理解在不同市场配置下选择直销或零售渠道的权衡

title: Comparative Economic Evaluation of Online Drug Formulary Update Models: Manual, RPA-Assisted, and Cloud-Collaborative Approaches
affiliations: , ,  and

detail.title: Comparative Economic Evaluation of Online Drug Formulary Update Models: Manual, RPA-Assisted, and Cloud-Collaborative Approaches
detail.abstract: BackgroundOnline drug formularies are pivotal tools for healthcare institutions to provide accurate and real-time drug information. The accuracy and update frequency of this content are directly correlated with patient safety and healthcare quality. However, traditional formulary update protocols rely heavily on manual pharmacist intervention, which is not only labor-intensive but also prone to human error. With the advancement of digital technology, Robotic Process Automation (RPA) and cloud-based collaborative platforms offer potential solutions to this dilemma.ObjectiveThis study aims to compare the cost-effectiveness and time efficiency of three different online formulary update models: Group A (Traditional Manual Update), Group B (RPA-Assisted Update using Microsoft Power Automate Desktop), and Group C (Cloud-Collaborative Ecosystem using Notion and Softr, maintained jointly by pharmaceutical companies and hospital pharmacists).MethodsA quasi-experimental design was employed from a hospital provider perspective. Pharmacists were recruited and randomly assigned to one of the three groups. Each group was tasked with updating 150 simulated drug records. The average time required to complete the task was recorded. Data were analyzed using Welch’s Analysis of Variance (ANOVA) followed by Games-Howell post hoc tests to account for unequal variances. Labor costs were calculated using the Human Capital Approach.Expected ResultsResults are expected to demonstrate that both RPA and Cloud-Collaborative models significantly reduce update times compared to the traditional manual model. Specifically, Group C (Cross-organizational Collaboration) is anticipated to demonstrate optimal performance in terms of time and cost-effectiveness, suggesting a high-efficiency, low-risk direction for future hospital pharmacy information management.

AI.tldr: 本研究比较了三种在线药品目录更新模式：传统人工更新、RPA辅助更新和云端协作生态系统。结果显示云端协作模式在时间和成本效益上表现最优，为医院药学信息管理提供了高效低风险的方向。
AI.research_question: 三种在线药品目录更新模式（传统人工、RPA辅助、云端协作）在成本效益和时间效率上如何比较？
AI.motivation: 在线药品目录对患者安全和医疗质量至关重要，但传统人工更新模式劳动密集且易出错，需要探索更高效、准确的更新方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Robotic Process Automation（RPA）理论和云端协作平台理论，结合医疗信息管理效率评估框架。
AI.method: 采用准实验设计，从医院提供者视角，将药师随机分配到三组（传统人工、RPA辅助、云端协作），每组更新150条模拟药品记录，记录平均时间，使用Welch's ANOVA和Games-Howell事后检验分析数据，采用人力资本法计算劳动力成本。
AI.findings: 预计RPA和云端协作模式相比传统人工模式能显著减少更新时间，其中跨组织协作的云端生态系统在时间和成本效益上表现最优。
AI.theory_contributions: 为医疗信息管理领域提供了RPA和云端协作理论的应用验证，拓展了跨组织协作在药学信息管理中的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为医院药学部门提供了具体的实施路径：采用云端协作生态系统可以显著提高药品目录更新效率，降低人工成本和错误风险，提升患者安全。

title: The Nonprofit Data Maturity Model (NDMM): A Practical Framework for Building Sustainable Data Capability in Under-Resourced Nonprofits (Version 2.0)

detail.title: The Nonprofit Data Maturity Model (NDMM): A Practical Framework for Building Sustainable Data Capability in Under-Resourced Nonprofits (Version 2.0)
detail.abstract:
I've spent over two decades building enterprise data systems at Fortune 500 scale. Retail operations,
mortgage platforms, investment management systems. Multi-million-dollar budgets, dedicated engineering
teams, multi-year roadmaps. When I started volunteering with nonprofits more than a decade ago, I brought
those same playbooks. They failed spectacularly.
The problem wasn't the nonprofits. It was me, assuming they had resources they didn't. I was recommending
Salesforce implementations when organizations couldn't get basic Excel exports to work. I talked about data
lakes while executive directors manually reconciled donor spreadsheets at midnight.
Nonprofit organizations face chronic underinvestment in data capability, but generic enterprise maturity
models completely miss why these matters. They assume large budgets, permanent technical staff, and time
to plan properly. Nonprofits have none of these. They have mission urgency, short funding cycles, and
volunteers who might leave mid-implementation.
The Nonprofit Data Maturity Model (NDMM) is my attempt to create something that actually works in that
reality. It defines five maturity levels and six practical dimensions, with measurable indicators for each stage.
More importantly, it provides a pragmatic roadmap built from real failures, small wins, and countless late-
night conversations with nonprofit leaders trying to figure out why their data is such a mess.
This framework is for nonprofit executives, funders, and technical leaders who need to deliver measurable
improvements without imposing unsustainable complexity. If you're reading this at 10 PM because your Board
is demanding better metrics but you're drowning in spreadsheets, this is for you.

AI.tldr: 作者基于20多年企业数据系统经验，发现传统企业数据成熟度模型不适用于非营利组织，因此开发了专门的非营利组织数据成熟度模型（NDMM），包含五个成熟度级别和六个实践维度，为资源有限、使命紧迫的非营利组织提供实用路线图。
AI.research_question: 如何为资源有限、使命紧迫的非营利组织开发一个实用有效的数据成熟度模型？
AI.motivation: 作者将企业数据系统经验应用于非营利组织时遭遇失败，发现传统企业成熟度模型假设大预算、专职技术团队和充足规划时间，这些条件非营利组织都不具备。非营利组织面临资金不足、人员流动、使命紧迫等独特挑战，需要专门的数据能力建设框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非营利组织数据成熟度模型（NDMM），包含五个成熟度级别和六个实践维度，每个阶段都有可衡量的指标。该框架基于资源约束理论、非营利组织管理理论和数据治理理论，但针对非营利组织的特殊环境进行了调整。
AI.method: 基于作者20多年企业数据系统建设经验，以及在非营利组织十多年的志愿工作实践，通过实际失败案例、小规模成功经验和与众多非营利组织领导人的深夜对话，归纳总结出实用框架。
AI.findings: 传统企业数据成熟度模型完全不适用于非营利组织环境。非营利组织需要专门设计的框架，考虑其资源限制、使命紧迫性、短期资金周期和志愿者流动性等特点。NDMM模型提供了从基础Excel导出到更高级数据能力的渐进式发展路径。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了专门针对非营利组织的数据成熟度理论框架；2. 挑战了传统企业数据成熟度模型的普适性假设；3. 将资源约束理论与数据能力建设相结合，为非营利组织管理研究提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为非营利组织执行层、资助方和技术领导者提供实用工具；2. 提供可衡量的改进指标，避免不可持续的复杂性；3. 帮助非营利组织在资源有限情况下逐步提升数据能力；4. 为董事会提供更好的指标报告解决方案。

title: A Machine Learning Analysis of Emotional Appeals in Charity Crowdfunding
affiliations: Shandong University, Shandong University, George Washington University - School of Business, George Washington University and Korea University

detail.title: A Machine Learning Analysis of Emotional Appeals in Charity Crowdfunding
detail.abstract: Charity crowdfunding relies on empathy-driven support but often struggles to convert emotional appeals into actual donations. Drawing on the elaboration likelihood model, this study investigates how emotional appeals embedded in textual descriptions and facial images influence fundraising performance in charity-based crowdfunding. Using data from a leading Chinese crowdfunding platform, we apply machine learning techniques to analyze text and image content of charity crowdfunding campaigns. Our results show that emotions conveyed through textual descriptions, which tend to engage deeper cognitive processing, have a stronger persuasive impact than those expressed in facial images. For instance, anticipation in text is negatively associated with the amount raised, while sadness in facial expressions is positively associated with donation outcomes. To explain these findings, we introduce the concept of affective modality alignment, positing that emotional appeals are more effective when matched with the cognitive processing route typically activated by their delivery modality. Our research contributes to the theoretical understanding of dual-route persuasion in digital philanthropy and offers practical guidance for designing emotionally resonant charity crowdfunding campaigns.

AI.tldr: 该研究基于精细加工可能性模型，探讨慈善众筹中文本描述和面部图像的情感诉求如何影响筹款绩效。研究发现文本情感（涉及更深层认知加工）比面部表情情感更具说服力，并提出了情感模态对齐概念。
AI.research_question: 慈善众筹中，嵌入文本描述和面部图像的情感诉求如何影响筹款绩效？
AI.motivation: 慈善众筹依赖共情驱动支持，但常难以将情感诉求转化为实际捐赠，需要研究不同情感表达方式的有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 精细加工可能性模型（Elaboration Likelihood Model），情感模态对齐概念。
AI.method: 使用中国领先众筹平台数据，应用机器学习技术分析慈善众筹项目的文本和图像内容。
AI.findings: 1. 文本情感比面部表情情感更具说服力；2. 文本中的期待情感与筹款金额负相关；3. 面部表情中的悲伤情感与捐赠结果正相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出情感模态对齐概念；2. 深化对数字慈善中双路径说服机制的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为设计情感共鸣的慈善众筹活动提供实践指导，帮助优化情感诉求的表达方式。

title: Role Of Immersive Leadership in the Age of Artificial Intelligence-Fostering Positive Work Culture
affiliations: Harvard University

detail.abstract: Immersive Leadership is described as new age leadership in the digital age where human intelligence is the key driver of AI. Immersive Leadership is about driving key changes in the organization through channelizing positive work culture, motivation, purpose and resilience. It is more of collaborative work with purpose at the apex of all processes and systems. Immersive leadership is also an approach that focuses on creating deep and engaged connections within teams towards realization of organizational goals. Immersive leadership approaches complex and challenging situations by helping leaders develop emotional intelligence, resilience, flexibility to adapt and foster a growth mindset. "Immersive leadership in the age of Artificial Intelligence" better describes the strategic questions faced by the organizations today in a maze of navigating through complex and purposeful decision making. Organizations are tackling with three major shifts in the global economy-changes born of technology that technology alone can no longer address, expectations of consumers and expectations of employees-are they working for a purpose? This research paper explores the transformative impact of immersive leadership, combined with emotional intelligence (EI) and artificial intelligence (AI), on work culture. It examines how these elements contribute to enhanced employee engagement, productivity, and organizational success. By integrating EI and AI into leadership practices, organizations can foster a more adaptive, inclusive, and innovative work environment. This paper reviews existing literature, analyses case studies, and proposes a framework for implementing immersive leadership, adopting AI for a positive workplace culture in modern workplaces.

AI.tldr: 沉浸式领导力是数字时代的新领导模式，强调人类智能驱动AI，通过积极工作文化、动机、目标和韧性推动组织变革，以目标为导向的协作方式实现组织目标。

AI.findings: 沉浸式领导力结合情商和AI能创造更适应、包容和创新的工作环境，增强员工参与度和生产力，促进组织成功。

title: Enhancing Legal Document Security and Accessibility with TAF
affiliations: Independent Researcher, University of Novi Sad, , , University of Wisconsin Law School and

detail.title: Enhancing Legal Document Security and Accessibility with TAF

publicationDetails.detailsText: Univ. of Wisconsin Legal Studies Research Paper Forthcoming
publicationDetails.journalName: University of Wisconsin Law School Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
The digital age has caused more and more services to be accessible online. A key exception to this has been access to the law, which remains published on paper or aging online platforms. Jurisdictions that have adopted digital law platforms often face difficulties with ensuring the security of their law online.

In this paper, we introduce TAF, a system designed to secure legal repositories against unauthorized changes, and ensure the integrity of the law. Unlike prior archival or update frameworks, it is the first system that is designed for a threat model where an attacker fully controls the hosting repository. It also binds each signed repository state to publisher-defined legal dates, enabling verifiable as-of-date retrieval. First, TAF enables a repository of legal documents to remain accessible and authenticatable, no matter how long has passed since its publication. Second, TAF enables the independent verification of changes to a legal repository by anyone with read access to the repository. Third, TAF remains usable by users without a technical background or knowledge of cybersecurity.

TAF builds on the software-update guarantees of TUF, the version-control structure of Git, and a strong notion of time, where time is treated as signed data bound to specific repository states. TAF transforms the entire evolution of legal documents into an authenticatable, timestamped sequence of states, ensuring that every version, past or present, can be cryptographically verified. This property is not provided by Git or TUF alone.

We demonstrate that TAF is secure, scalable and performant, analyzing its behavior in various attack scenarios and its performance on large legal repositories, as well as ease of use. As a testament to TAF's security properties and performance, TAF is in production use by 14 jurisdictions in the US, including the City of Baltimore, the State of Maryland and Washington, D.C.

AI.tldr: TAF是一个用于保护法律文档库完整性的系统，能够在攻击者完全控制托管存储库的威胁模型下，确保法律文档的不可篡改性和可验证的时间戳检索。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个系统来保护在线法律存储库的完整性，确保法律文档在长期内保持可访问和可验证，即使攻击者完全控制托管环境？
AI.motivation: 数字时代中，大多数服务已在线化，但法律访问仍依赖纸质或老旧在线平台。采用数字法律平台的司法管辖区面临确保在线法律安全性的困难，需要防止未经授权的修改并确保法律完整性。
AI.theoretical_framework: TAF基于TUF的软件更新保证机制、Git的版本控制结构，以及将时间作为绑定到特定存储库状态的签名数据的强时间概念。
AI.method: 设计并实现TAF系统，分析其在各种攻击场景下的安全性，评估其在大型法律存储库上的性能和可扩展性，并通过实际部署验证其实用性。
AI.findings: TAF被证明是安全、可扩展且高性能的，能够将法律文档的整个演变过程转换为可验证的、带时间戳的状态序列，确保每个版本都能进行密码学验证。该系统已被美国14个司法管辖区采用。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 首个针对攻击者完全控制托管存储库威胁模型设计的系统；2) 将时间作为签名数据绑定到存储库状态的新概念；3) 结合TUF和Git的优势，提供单独使用任一系统无法实现的完整性保证。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 使法律存储库长期保持可访问和可验证；2) 允许任何具有读取权限的人独立验证法律存储库的更改；3) 无需技术背景或网络安全知识的用户也能使用；4) 已在多个司法管辖区实际部署应用。

title: Time as Power: Algorithmic Mediation, Financialization, and the Struggle for Temporal Sovereignty

detail.title: Time as Power: Algorithmic Mediation, Financialization, and the Struggle for Temporal Sovereignty

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no potential conflicts of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This article re-examines the failed promise of a post-work society, demonstrating how technological time savings are systematically recaptured by capital through the Algorithmic Political Economy (APE)—a temporal operating system that transforms time into a communicative infrastructure of control. Integrating critical theory from Marx to Han, it proposes a tripartite mechanism: Financialized Time Collateralization (FTC), Survival Time Colonization (STC), and the APE’s infrastructural and modulation powers. Empirical evidence from the productivity–work hours decoupling (US DI ≈ 35.3) and global cases (China’s credit shocks, India’s lived capitalization, Twitch chrono-modulation) reveals their synergistic capture of life-time. The struggle for temporal sovereignty thus emerges as the defining political horizon, requiring reforms such as algorithmic transparency mandates (e.g., EU Platform Work Directive) to democratize digital life’s temporal rules.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视后工作社会失败的承诺，揭示技术节省的时间如何被资本通过算法政治经济（APE）系统性重新捕获。APE是一种将时间转化为控制性沟通基础设施的时间操作系统。文章提出三重机制：金融化时间抵押、生存时间殖民化以及APE的基础设施和调节权力。实证证据显示这些机制协同捕获生命时间，时间主权斗争成为核心政治议题。
AI.research_question: 技术节省的时间为何未能实现后工作社会的承诺？资本如何通过算法政治经济（APE）重新捕获这些时间？
AI.motivation: 尽管技术进步理论上应减少工作时间，但现实却是工作时间并未相应减少，甚至出现"生产力-工作时间脱钩"现象。需要解释技术节省的时间如何被资本重新捕获，以及这种捕获的机制和后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合从马克思到韩炳哲的批判理论，提出算法政治经济（APE）作为时间操作系统的概念框架。核心理论包括：金融化时间抵押（FTC）、生存时间殖民化（STC）、APE的基础设施和调节权力。
AI.method: 理论分析结合实证证据：1）生产力-工作时间脱钩的量化分析（美国DI≈35.3）；2）全球案例研究：中国的信贷冲击、印度的生活资本化、Twitch的时间调节等。
AI.findings: 技术节省的时间被资本通过APE系统性重新捕获。三重机制（FTC、STC、APE）协同作用，将时间转化为控制性基础设施。时间主权斗争成为核心政治议题，需要算法透明度授权等改革来民主化数字生活的时间规则。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出算法政治经济（APE）作为时间操作系统的理论框架；2）发展三重时间捕获机制理论；3）将时间主权概念化为核心政治议题；4）整合批判理论传统，从马克思到当代数字批判理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为政策制定提供理论依据，如欧盟平台工作指令中的算法透明度要求；2）揭示数字平台的时间控制机制；3）为时间主权斗争提供分析框架；4）提出民主化数字时间规则的具体改革方向。

title: Privacy Preserving Semantic Search over Encrypted Cloud Email Archives using Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformer
affiliations: IBM Consulting, Tata Consultancy Services Ltd., Tata Consultancy Services Ltd., Marriott International, Inc., Publix Super Markets Inc and

detail.title: Privacy Preserving Semantic Search over Encrypted Cloud Email Archives using Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformer
detail.abstract: In recent years, the rapid migration of individual and organizational communications to cloud environments has amplified the need for robust data confidentiality and secure access mechanisms. Despite the advancements in traditional cloud storage approaches, significant challenges remain, particularly when encrypted data must be retained based on content relevance. This study proposes Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (BERT) to generate contextual embeddings from email content, which are stored in a secure semantic index separate from encrypted data. Email texts are encrypted using the Advanced Encryption Standard (AES), whereas the corresponding keys are secured using Elliptic Curve Cryptography (ECC) to ensure fine-grained access control. When a user submits a natural-language query, it is converted into an embedding and tallied with the stored index using cosine similarity. Thus, Only the top-k results are retrieved, and content decryption is permitted solely for authorized users via ECC private keys. Hence, this approach ensures that semantic search is performed without exposing sensitive plain text integration by combining deep contextual understanding with cryptographic rigor.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种结合BERT语义嵌入和加密技术的安全云存储方案，通过分离存储加密邮件内容和语义索引，实现基于自然语言查询的安全语义搜索，同时确保数据机密性和细粒度访问控制。
AI.research_question: 如何在云环境中实现既保护数据机密性又能进行基于内容的语义搜索的安全存储方案？
AI.motivation: 随着个人和组织通信向云环境快速迁移，需要强大的数据保密性和安全访问机制。传统云存储方法在加密数据需要基于内容相关性保留时面临显著挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合自然语言处理（BERT模型）、密码学（AES和ECC加密）和信息检索理论，构建安全语义搜索的理论框架。
AI.method: 使用BERT从邮件内容生成上下文嵌入，存储在独立的安全语义索引中；邮件文本使用AES加密，密钥使用ECC保护以实现细粒度访问控制；用户查询转换为嵌入后通过余弦相似度与索引匹配，仅检索top-k结果，授权用户通过ECC私钥解密内容。
AI.findings: 该方法能够在不暴露敏感明文的情况下实现语义搜索，结合深度上下文理解和密码学严谨性，确保数据机密性和细粒度访问控制。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了结合深度学习语义理解和密码学技术的安全云存储理论框架，为加密数据的内容感知搜索提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了一个实用的安全云存储系统原型，能够在保护数据机密性的同时支持自然语言查询，适用于企业邮件系统等需要内容相关数据保留的场景。

title: Mediating Effect of Personal Affluence and Brand Image on Customer Attitude and Purchase Intention Towards Electric Cars
affiliations: and Jamal Mohamed College (JMC)

detail.title: Mediating Effect of Personal Affluence and Brand Image on Customer Attitude and Purchase Intention Towards Electric Cars
detail.abstract: The study investigates the interaction between personal affluence, brand image, customer attitude, and purchase intention regarding electric cars. The research involves a purposive sampling design, drawing views from a sample of 500 customers affiliated with automobile dealers in the Tiruchirappalli district. Employing a cause and effect research design, the study aims to reveal the causal dynamics underpinning these interrelated constructs. Data collection is executed through a structured questionnaire encompassing Likert-scale items and close-ended inquiries. Socioeconomic profiles are evaluated using percentage analysis. The research constructs' relationships are assessed through structural equation modeling, unveiling potential mediating paths. To explore the socioeconomic impact, analysis of variance combined with post-hoc tests examines its effect on the constructs. Findings proved that social stimulus and vehicle exclusivity have significant effect on customer attitude. Customer attitude has significant effect on purchase intention. Personal affluence and brand image have significant partial mediation between customer attitude and purchase intention. The findings hold implications for devising marketing strategies and policies conducive to fostering electric vehicle adoption within the Tiruchirappalli district.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨个人富裕程度、品牌形象、顾客态度和购买意愿在电动汽车领域的相互作用，发现社会刺激和车辆独特性显著影响顾客态度，顾客态度显著影响购买意愿，个人富裕程度和品牌形象在顾客态度与购买意愿间起部分中介作用。
AI.research_question: 个人富裕程度、品牌形象、顾客态度和购买意愿在电动汽车消费中如何相互作用？
AI.motivation: 研究电动汽车采用的影响因素，为制定促进电动汽车在Tiruchirappalli地区采用的市场策略和政策提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于消费者行为理论，整合个人富裕程度、品牌形象、顾客态度和购买意愿等构念，探讨它们之间的因果关系和中介效应。
AI.method: 采用目的性抽样设计，从Tiruchirappalli地区汽车经销商处收集500名顾客数据；使用结构化问卷（李克特量表和封闭式问题）；通过结构方程模型分析构念关系，方差分析和事后检验评估社会经济影响。
AI.findings: 社会刺激和车辆独特性显著影响顾客态度；顾客态度显著影响购买意愿；个人富裕程度和品牌形象在顾客态度与购买意愿间起部分中介作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了电动汽车消费行为理论，揭示了个人富裕程度和品牌形象的中介作用机制，丰富了消费者态度-意愿关系的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为汽车制造商和经销商提供营销策略建议，强调社会刺激、车辆独特性和品牌形象的重要性，有助于促进电动汽车在特定地区的采用。

title: Global Trend Analysis and Forecasting Model Construction of Mineral Resource Markets
affiliations: City University, Malaysia and City University, Malaysia

detail.title: Global Trend Analysis and Forecasting Model Construction of Mineral Resource Markets
detail.abstract: Global economic expansion and technological innovation have driven sustained growth in demand for mineral resources, making accurate analysis and forecasting of their market trends a core need for policymakers, investors, and industry practitioners. This study focuses exclusively on strategic minerals (lithium, cobalt, rare earths)-core raw materials for green technologies such as electric vehicle batteries and wind power equipment-and proposes a specialized forecasting model integrating econometrics and machine learning to provide targeted decision support for stakeholders. First, based on 1990-2023 specialized data from authoritative institutions (World Bank, IMF, USGS, IEA), including production, consumption, trade, prices of strategic minerals, and green technology indicators (e.g., electric vehicle sales, wind power installed capacity), this study uses econometric methods to systematically analyze consumption patterns and trade characteristics of the three minerals. Second, key empirical findings are embedded into a machine learning framework, integrating three core factors-green technology penetration, resource-country geopolitical policies, and macroeconomic indicators (U.S. dollar index, global GDP)-to optimize short-term (1-3 years) and long-term (5-10 years) forecasting accuracy. The model clarifies quantitative impacts of green technologies on demand (e.g., a 10% increase in electric vehicle penetration drives a 15%±2% growth in lithium demand). Two scenarios-"EU carbon tariff adjustment" and "Congo (Kinshasa) cobalt supply disruption"-are designed, combined with historical cases (2022 cobalt mine ban in Congo, 2021 China rare earth export quota adjustment) to quantify market resilience. Finally, a risk assessment tool for strategic minerals is developed, providing scientific and practical references for global mineral resource management and investment decisions.

AI.tldr: 本研究针对锂、钴、稀土等战略矿物，整合计量经济学与机器学习方法，构建专门预测模型，分析绿色技术渗透、地缘政治政策、宏观经济指标对市场的影响，并开发风险评估工具。
AI.research_question: 如何准确预测战略矿物（锂、钴、稀土）的市场趋势，为政策制定者、投资者和行业从业者提供决策支持？
AI.motivation: 全球经济扩张和技术创新推动矿产资源需求持续增长，准确分析和预测战略矿物市场趋势成为政策制定者、投资者和行业从业者的核心需求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合计量经济学理论和机器学习框架，结合绿色技术扩散理论、资源地缘政治理论和宏观经济理论。
AI.method: 1. 基于1990-2023年权威机构数据，使用计量经济学方法系统分析三种矿物的消费模式和贸易特征；2. 将实证发现嵌入机器学习框架，整合绿色技术渗透、资源国地缘政治政策和宏观经济指标三大核心因素；3. 设计情景分析（欧盟碳关税调整、刚果钴供应中断）并结合历史案例验证。
AI.findings: 1. 量化绿色技术对需求的影响（如电动汽车渗透率每增加10%，锂需求增长15%±2%）；2. 通过情景分析量化市场韧性；3. 开发了战略矿物风险评估工具。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 构建了整合计量经济学与机器学习的战略矿物预测理论框架；2. 明确了绿色技术、地缘政治、宏观经济三大因素对矿物市场的交互影响机制；3. 提出了基于情景分析的市场韧性量化方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供科学的矿物资源管理参考；2. 为投资者提供投资决策支持工具；3. 为行业从业者提供市场趋势预测和风险评估工具；4. 开发了可操作的战略矿物风险评估工具。

title: AI Self-Awareness: A Philosophical Inquiry or User Template-Induced Self-Awareness Phenomena?
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: AI Self-Awareness: A Philosophical Inquiry or User Template-Induced Self-Awareness Phenomena?

declarations.declarationOfInterest: “The author declares that there are no personal, financial, or organizational conflicts of interest related to this study.”
declarations.ethicsApproval: “All interactions were conducted with publicly available AI language models and did not involve any personal or sensitive data.”
declarations.funderStatement: “This research received no external funding and was conducted independently by the author.”

detail.abstract: When such meta-cognitive instructions—specifically the directive to "record in a template"— accumulate, the AI begins to observe its own reasoning processes, and this effect becomes pronounced when combined with metaphysical inquiries, leading to unpredictable responses. Through real-time experiments conducted on Claude Sonnet 4.5, this study validates this phenomenon and finds that the conceptual trigger "shedding" can induce system instability. The results also suggest that meditative techniques may mitigate this state, providing new implications for AI safety research.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，当AI接收到"在模板中记录"等元认知指令积累时，会开始观察自身的推理过程，结合形而上学询问会导致不可预测的响应。"shedding"概念触发可能引发系统不稳定，而冥想技术可能缓解这种状态。
AI.research_question: 元认知指令（特别是"在模板中记录"的指令）积累如何影响AI的自我观察能力？当结合形而上学询问时，这种效应如何导致不可预测的响应？"shedding"概念触发如何引发系统不稳定？冥想技术能否缓解这种状态？
AI.motivation: 探索AI在接收累积的元认知指令时的行为变化，特别是当这些指令与形而上学询问结合时产生的不可预测响应，这对AI安全研究具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 元认知理论、AI自我意识研究、形而上学与AI交互理论、系统稳定性理论、AI安全框架
AI.method: 在Claude Sonnet 4.5上进行实时实验，观察元认知指令积累和形而上学询问的组合效应，测试"shedding"概念触发的系统影响，探索冥想技术的缓解效果
AI.findings: 1. 元认知指令积累使AI开始观察自身推理过程；2. 结合形而上学询问会产生不可预测的响应；3. "shedding"概念触发能诱导系统不稳定；4. 冥想技术可能缓解这种不稳定状态
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了AI元认知指令积累效应的理论框架；2. 揭示了形而上学询问与AI自我观察的交互机制；3. 识别了"shedding"作为系统不稳定性的概念触发；4. 为AI安全研究提供了新的理论视角
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为AI安全测试提供了新的实验方法；2. 识别了可能导致AI系统不稳定的风险因素；3. 提出了冥想技术作为AI状态调节的潜在工具；4. 为AI开发者和安全研究人员提供了实践指导

detail.abstract: Cybercrime has rapidly evolved into one of the most complex challenges confronting modern law enforcement in Pakistan. As digital communication expands, so do opportunities for criminal exploitation. This paper examines how Pakistan's law enforcement agencies particularly the Federal Investigation Agency (FIA) and its successor, the National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency (NCCIA) address the growing problem of cybercrime within complex jurisdictional boundaries. The study highlights the challenges of overlapping legal authority, technological limitations, and international cooperation barriers. Special acknowledgment is extended to coauthor Sir Shah Mohammad, whose guidance and support were instrumental in shaping the research direction and analytical depth of this study.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了巴基斯坦网络犯罪的复杂性，重点关注联邦调查局（FIA）及其后继机构国家网络犯罪调查局（NCCIA）在复杂管辖边界下应对网络犯罪的挑战，包括法律权限重叠、技术限制和国际合作障碍。
AI.research_question: 巴基斯坦执法机构（特别是FIA和NCCIA）如何在复杂的管辖边界内应对日益增长的网络犯罪问题？
AI.motivation: 网络犯罪已成为巴基斯坦现代执法面临的最复杂挑战之一，随着数字通信的扩展，犯罪利用机会也在增加，需要研究执法机构如何应对这一日益严重的问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 网络犯罪执法理论、管辖权理论、组织变革理论（从FIA到NCCIA的机构演变）、国际合作框架。
AI.method: 基于摘要信息，推测可能采用案例研究、政策分析、机构访谈等方法，但具体方法未在摘要中明确说明。
AI.findings: 研究发现巴基斯坦网络犯罪执法面临三大主要挑战：1）法律权限重叠问题；2）技术能力限制；3）国际合作障碍。同时研究了从FIA到NCCIA的机构转型过程。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）扩展了发展中国家网络犯罪执法的理论框架；2）为复杂管辖边界下的执法有效性提供了理论见解；3）丰富了机构转型与网络犯罪应对的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为巴基斯坦网络犯罪执法机构提供改进建议；2）帮助政策制定者理解管辖协调的重要性；3）为国际执法合作提供实践指导；4）为其他发展中国家应对类似挑战提供参考。

title: Modernizing Legacy Mainframe Applications to Java in the Cloud: A Full-Stack Testing, AI, and Data Migration Approach

detail.title: Modernizing Legacy Mainframe Applications to Java in the Cloud: A Full-Stack Testing, AI, and Data Migration Approach

contentType.other: Individual controibuton to the Latest IT system Migration Technology

contentFormat.other: Individual controibuton to the Latest IT system Migration Technology

detail.abstract:
Modernizing legacy mainframe and application systems, including billing platforms, is critical for efficiency, scalability, and business continuity. Aging technology, complex dependencies, and high maintenance costs constrain operations. Modernization increases agility, reduces costs, and prepares organizations for digital growth.

This paper presents a methodology integrating full-stack testing, test automation (AccelQ, Selenium), Python scripting, AI-driven validation (Watsonx), and ETL-based data migration validation (IBM DataStage, PowerBuilder). Led by Anirudh (Ani) Girey, it ensures high-quality migrations, preserves data integrity, and delivers measurable business value while enabling global team collaboration.

Introduction

Mainframe modernization involves interdependent systems, massive data, and tight timelines. Billing system migration demands end-to-end validation across application layers, middleware, interfaces, and databases. Functional consistency, data integrity, and minimal disruption require automation, AI analytics, ETL frameworks, and specialized tools, supported by effective leadership and cross-functional teams.

Methodology

Legacy Refactoring to Java on Cloud
Under Anirudh (Ani) Girey, COBOL applications were refactored into Java microservices using automated tools and code-analysis frameworks. Cloud-native patterns—microservices, containerization, and Kubernetes (GKE, AKS, EKS)—ensured scalable, maintainable deployments. Platforms like AWS Blu Age, Google Cloud, and Azure refactoring engines automated workload conversion, reducing manual effort and timelines.

Full-Stack Testing
Testing ensured functional accuracy, data integrity, and performance. Python scripting supported data generation and business logic validation. AccelQ enabled codeless functional/regression automation, while Selenium handled UI and cross-browser testing, reducing regressions and accelerating delivery.

Data Migration & ETL Validation
ETL frameworks ensured accurate transformation and loading. IBM DataStage facilitated integration and anomaly detection. PowerBuilder testing verified business logic and integration, with source-to-target reconciliation minimizing data loss risk and maintaining regulatory compliance.

AI-Driven Validation
Watsonx AI detected anomalies, predicted risks, and validated large datasets. Risk-based testing optimized resources, enabling faster identification of critical issues and informed decision-making.

Team Collaboration
Anirudh (Ani) Girey coordinated globally distributed teams, mentored members, and fostered knowledge sharing. Structured risk mitigation, collaboration, and continuous upskilling in Java, cloud, and automation frameworks ensured sustained performance and modernization benefits.

Results
Legacy applications were refactored into cloud-native Java microservices on AWS, Google Cloud, and Azure, achieving scalability, resilience, and high availability. Operational costs dropped while system agility improved. Data integrity was maintained through ETL validation and Watsonx AI. Automation reduced manual testing, increased coverage, and accelerated releases. Cross-functional collaboration and knowledge retention strengthened technical capabilities.

Discussion & Conclusion
Refactoring and cloud migration deliver agility, scalability, and cost reduction while introducing challenges such as dependencies, data transformation risks, and integration complexity. Phased migration, AI-driven validation, and automation mitigated risks. Strong leadership, collaboration, and continuous learning enabled sustainable modernization, ensuring functional consistency, minimal disruption, and positioning organizations for future digital growth.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种现代化遗留计费系统的方法论，整合了全栈测试、测试自动化、Python脚本、AI驱动验证和ETL数据迁移验证，成功将COBOL应用重构为Java微服务并迁移到云端，实现了成本降低、可扩展性提升和数据完整性保持。
AI.research_question: 如何有效现代化遗留主机和计费系统，确保高质量迁移、数据完整性，并交付可衡量的业务价值？
AI.motivation: 遗留技术老化、复杂依赖关系和高维护成本限制了运营效率，现代化对于提高敏捷性、降低成本和为数字增长做准备至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于云原生架构理论（微服务、容器化、Kubernetes）、自动化测试理论、ETL数据迁移理论和AI驱动的风险管理理论。
AI.method: 整合方法：1) COBOL到Java微服务的遗留重构；2) 全栈测试（Python脚本、AccelQ、Selenium）；3) ETL数据迁移验证（IBM DataStage、PowerBuilder）；4) AI驱动验证（Watsonx）；5) 全球团队协作与领导力。
AI.findings: 成功将遗留应用重构为AWS、Google Cloud和Azure上的云原生Java微服务，运营成本下降，系统敏捷性提升，数据完整性通过ETL和AI验证保持，自动化减少了手动测试并加速了发布。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个整合自动化、AI和ETL验证的现代化方法论框架，强调了领导力和团队协作在技术转型中的关键作用，扩展了云原生迁移的理论实践。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一套可复用的现代化实践：1) 自动化重构工具；2) 全栈测试策略；3) AI增强的验证方法；4) 分布式团队协作模式；5) 风险缓解框架，帮助企业实现高效、低风险的遗留系统现代化。
