AI.theoretical_framework: 伊斯兰良好公司治理(GCG)理论和环境、社会、治理(ESG)框架，以及两者的整合理论。
AI.method: 定性文献研究法，收集和分析过去五年内的期刊文章、研究报告和政策文件。

title: DNA-Inspired Time Series Encoding: A Glimpse Into The Next 4-Hour Timeframe

detail.title: DNA-Inspired Time Series Encoding: A Glimpse Into The Next 4-Hour Timeframe
detail.abstract: In this work, we introduce a bio-inspired encoding framework for forecasting the direction of financial time series. Motivated by the limitations of linear models and the opacity of many deep learning approaches, we draw an analogy to genetics: observable micro-patterns are encoded into symbolic "Financial DNA" sequences. These sequences are then analyzed using a probabilistic state-transition mechanism to estimate the likelihood of subsequent market directions. We evaluate the approach on Bitcoin hourly OHLCV data with a rolling backtest. Among the horizons considered, modeling transitions from current Financial DNA patterns to the 4-hour-ahead price direction yields the strongest results, achieving a win ratio of 0.729. The findings suggest that compact, interpretable symbolic representations can capture salient, recurring structures in noisy, non-stationary markets and support effective directional forecasts.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种受生物启发的金融时间序列方向预测编码框架，将可观察的微观模式编码为符号化的"金融DNA"序列，并通过概率状态转移机制分析这些序列来预测市场方向。
AI.research_question: 如何利用生物启发的编码框架来预测金融时间序列的方向？具体来说，如何将可观察的微观模式编码为符号化的"金融DNA"序列，并通过概率状态转移机制来估计后续市场方向的可能性？
AI.motivation: 线性模型的局限性以及许多深度学习方法的不可解释性促使研究者寻找新的预测方法。受遗传学启发，作者希望通过将可观察的微观模式编码为符号化序列，创建更透明、可解释的预测框架。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 生物启发编码理论：借鉴遗传学中的DNA编码概念
2. 符号化表示理论：将复杂金融模式转化为离散符号序列
3. 概率状态转移理论：基于马尔可夫链或类似机制分析序列转移概率
AI.method:
1. 将可观察的微观模式编码为"金融DNA"符号序列
2. 使用概率状态转移机制分析序列
3. 在比特币小时OHLCV数据上进行滚动回测评估
4. 考虑不同时间范围，特别关注当前金融DNA模式到4小时前价格方向的转移建模
AI.findings:
1. 在考虑的时间范围中，建模从当前金融DNA模式到4小时前价格方向的转移效果最好
2. 实现了0.729的胜率
3. 紧凑、可解释的符号表示能够捕捉噪声、非平稳市场中显著的重现结构
4. 支持有效的方向预测
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出了金融DNA编码框架，将生物启发概念应用于金融预测
2. 发展了符号化表示理论在金融时间序列分析中的应用
3. 为可解释金融预测提供了新的理论视角
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 提供了一种透明、可解释的金融方向预测方法
2. 在比特币市场验证了方法的有效性（0.729胜率）
3. 为从业者提供了实用的预测工具，相比黑盒深度学习模型更具可解释性

title: Formal And Informal Writing Styles
affiliations: ,  and

detail.title: Formal And Informal Writing Styles
detail.abstract: This paper examines the key differences between formal and informal writing styles, focusing on their purposes, linguistic features, and appropriate contexts of use. Formal writing is typically used in academic, professional, and official communication, characterized by precise vocabulary, complex sentence structures, objective tone, and adherence to grammatical conventions. In contrast, informal writing is commonly found in personal messages, casual conversations, and digital communication; it features colloquial expressions, contractions, simpler sentence patterns, and a more personal or conversational tone. Understanding the distinctions between these styles enables writers to communicate more effectively by selecting the register that aligns with their audience and communicative goals. The study highlights the importance of audience awareness, situational context, and communicative purpose in choosing between formal and informal writing.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨正式与非正式写作风格的关键差异，包括其目的、语言特征和适用语境，强调根据受众和沟通目标选择合适语域的重要性。
AI.research_question: 正式与非正式写作风格有哪些关键差异？如何根据受众和沟通目标选择合适的写作风格？
AI.motivation: 帮助写作者理解不同写作风格的特点，提高沟通效果，使写作更符合特定语境和受众需求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 语域理论、文体学、语用学、社会语言学中的语境理论和受众分析理论。
AI.method: 对比分析法和描述性研究，通过文献综述和实例分析来探讨两种写作风格的特征差异。
AI.findings: 正式写作用于学术、专业和官方场合，具有精确词汇、复杂句式、客观语气和语法规范；非正式写作用于个人交流、日常对话和数字沟通，具有口语化表达、缩略形式、简单句式和个性化语气。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对语域选择理论的理解，为文体学提供了实用的分析框架，强调了语境和受众在写作风格选择中的决定性作用。

title: Islamic Business Ethics as the Foundation of Sharia Good Corporate Governance for Sustainability
affiliations: and

detail.title: Islamic Business Ethics as the Foundation of Sharia Good Corporate Governance for Sustainability

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that there is no conflict of interest related to this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not require ethics approval because it uses secondary data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: The purpose of this study is to examine how Islamic business ethics function as the basis for implementing Good Corporate Governance (GCG) based on Sharia in Indonesian Islamic financial institutions. Based on the values of justice ('adl), honesty (shiddiq), trust (amanah), accountability (mas'uliyyah), and transparency (tabligh), Islamic business ethics are considered a framework that guides economic behavior. A descriptive qualitative research methodology with a literature study approach was used, including a review of academic books, scientific literature, and official regulations from the National Sharia Council (DSN-MUI) and the Financial Services Authority (OJK) for the period 2022-2025. The results of the study show that the application of Sharia GCG, which is based on Islamic ethics, produces governance that is morally fair and honest as well as managerially effective. The five basic principles of GCG (transparency, accountability, responsibility, independence, and fairness) have been proven to be driven by the values of shiddiq, amanah, tabligh, and fathanah. Therefore, it can be said that Islamic business ethics serve as a moral compass and regulator that supports the objectives of maqashid al-syariah by upholding the values of justice and social responsibility and strengthening the implementation of Sharia GCG.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨伊斯兰商业伦理如何作为印尼伊斯兰金融机构实施基于伊斯兰教法的良好公司治理的基础，发现伊斯兰伦理价值观（公正、诚实、信任、问责、透明）驱动GCG五大原则，形成道德公平且管理有效的治理体系。
AI.research_question: 伊斯兰商业伦理如何作为印尼伊斯兰金融机构实施基于伊斯兰教法的良好公司治理（GCG）的基础？
AI.motivation: 需要探讨伊斯兰商业伦理在伊斯兰金融机构治理中的核心作用，以及如何通过伦理价值观支持伊斯兰教法目标的实现。
AI.theoretical_framework: 伊斯兰商业伦理框架（公正、诚实、信任、问责、透明）、良好公司治理（GCG）五大原则（透明、问责、责任、独立、公平）、maqashid al-syariah（伊斯兰教法目标）理论。
AI.method: 描述性定性研究方法，采用文献研究法，包括对学术书籍、科学文献以及国家伊斯兰教法委员会（DSN-MUI）和金融服务管理局（OJK）2022-2025年官方法规的回顾。
AI.findings: 基于伊斯兰伦理的伊斯兰GCG实施产生了道德公平、诚实且管理有效的治理；GCG五大原则被证明由伊斯兰伦理价值观（诚实、信任、透明、智慧）驱动；伊斯兰商业伦理作为道德指南和调节器，支持maqashid al-syariah目标。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了伊斯兰商业伦理与良好公司治理之间的理论联系，阐明了伊斯兰伦理价值观如何具体驱动GCG原则，丰富了伊斯兰金融治理的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印尼伊斯兰金融机构提供了基于伊斯兰伦理的治理实施指南，强调了伦理价值观在治理实践中的重要性，有助于提升伊斯兰金融机构的治理质量和公信力。

title: Silent Knowledge Gaps in Large Language Models and Pathways to Proactive Nourishment

detail.title: Silent Knowledge Gaps in Large Language Models and Pathways to Proactive Nourishment

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal, financial, or organizational conflicts of interest. This work was conducted independently, without funding or external influence. No entity or individual had any role in the conception, execution, or interpretation of the Empty Brain Hypothesis (EBH) study.

detail.abstract: The Empty Brain Hypothesis (EBH) proposes a model-agnostic framework for identifying silent epistemic gaps in large language models (LLMs). EBH formalizes a tri-state cognitive architecture—Satiated, Empty, and Overfed—capturing how LLMs drift into hallucinations, representational collapse, and biased overfitting. The Empty Brain Model (EBM) introduces operational metrics including perplexity spikes, semantic drift, and the Bayesian-inspired Gap Score G(t)G(t)G(t). The framework develops bio-inspired “hunger signals” and feeding protocols enabling proactive epistemic regulation. Experiments on Llama-3 variants show up to 42% hallucination reduction and F1 = 0.66 gap detection performance. A multi-model case study with Grok, Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, Perplexity AI, and NotebookLM reveals shared architectural voids. EBH reframes AI reliability as a problem of epistemic nourishment rather than data abundance.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了"空脑假说"框架，用于识别大型语言模型中的认知空白，通过三态认知架构和操作指标来检测和减少幻觉，实验显示幻觉减少达42%。
AI.research_question: 如何识别和量化大型语言模型中的沉默认知空白（epistemic gaps），以及如何通过认知调节机制减少幻觉和偏见过拟合？
AI.motivation: 当前LLM存在幻觉、表征崩溃和偏见过拟合问题，传统方法主要关注数据量而非认知质量，需要新的框架来理解和管理模型的认知状态。
AI.theoretical_framework: 空脑假说（EBH）框架，包括三态认知架构（饱足态、空态、过饱态）、空脑模型（EBM）的操作指标（困惑度峰值、语义漂移、贝叶斯启发的Gap Score G(t)）、生物启发的"饥饿信号"和喂养协议。
AI.method: 实验方法包括：在Llama-3变体上测试EBM指标，评估幻觉减少效果；多模型案例研究（Grok、Claude、Gemini、ChatGPT、Perplexity AI、NotebookLM）分析共享架构空白。
AI.findings: 1. Llama-3变体上实现高达42%的幻觉减少；2. Gap检测性能F1=0.66；3. 多模型研究揭示共享的架构空白；4. 证明认知调节机制的有效性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出模型无关的认知空白识别框架；2. 形式化三态认知架构；3. 引入操作指标量化认知状态；4. 将AI可靠性重新定义为认知滋养问题而非数据丰富性问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供可操作的幻觉检测和减少工具；2. 开发生物启发的认知调节协议；3. 为多模型系统设计提供指导；4. 提高LLM在实际应用中的可靠性。

title: Cognitive Fallow in AI Labour Markets: A Global Framework with an Australian Evidence Snapshot
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Cognitive Fallow in AI Labour Markets: A Global Framework with an Australian Evidence Snapshot
detail.abstract: This paper introduces cognitive fallow as a cohort level condition in which highly educated new entrants experience prolonged, involuntary under utilisation because artificial intelligence (AI) has automated or reallocated the entry level cognitive tasks that historically served as stepping stones into professional work. The concept is situated within task based technological change, graduate over education, and search and matching literatures. I formalise a simple mechanism in which AI reduces firms' incentives to post junior vacancies and raises experience thresholds, and propose a Cognitive Fallow Index (CFI) that can be implemented using standard labour market microdata. The CFI is defined as a composite of three components for exposed occupations: graduate underemployment, the median time to first relevant job, and the share of entry level postings in vacancy data. I distinguish between the full CFI, a data constrained CFI lite based on aggregate proxies, and a macro hazard based CFI L that uses cross country exit hazards from graduate unemployment to provide a simple comparative read on expected fallow durations. Empirically, I present two applications. First, an Australian snapshot for July 2025 shows that a national CFI lite constructed from the Internet Vacancy Index and Graduate Outcomes Survey does not signal a country wide cognitive fallow condition, which highlights how aggregation can mask field specific bottlenecks. Second, a macro hazard illustration for the United States, the European Union, China, and Australia demonstrates pronounced differences in expected fallow durations. The United States exhibits short spells while Australia records the longest. These cross country patterns underscore the importance of labour market slack and vacancy density, and show that AI readiness scores alone are not informative about entry level dynamics.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了"认知休耕"概念，指高学历新进入者因AI自动化了入门级认知任务而经历长期非自愿低度利用的状态。作者开发了认知休耕指数(CFI)来衡量这一现象，并通过澳大利亚和美国等国家的实证应用展示了各国在预期休耕持续时间上的显著差异。
AI.research_question: AI如何通过自动化入门级认知任务影响高学历新进入者的就业机会和职业发展路径？如何衡量和比较不同国家/地区的认知休耕状况？
AI.motivation: 随着AI技术的发展，许多传统上作为专业工作入门阶梯的认知任务被自动化或重新分配，导致高学历新进入者面临长期非自愿的低度利用状态，这一问题尚未得到充分研究和量化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于任务的技术变革理论、毕业生过度教育理论、以及搜寻匹配理论，将认知休耕概念化为群体层面的条件。
AI.method: 开发认知休耕指数(CFI)，包含三个组成部分：毕业生就业不足、找到第一份相关工作的中位时间、入门级职位在空缺数据中的份额。提出完整CFI、基于聚合代理的数据受限CFI Lite、以及使用跨国毕业生失业退出风险的宏观风险CFI L。
AI.findings: 1) 澳大利亚2025年7月的CFI Lite未显示全国性认知休耕状况，表明聚合数据可能掩盖特定领域的瓶颈；2) 美国、欧盟、中国和澳大利亚的宏观风险分析显示预期休耕持续时间存在显著差异，美国最短而澳大利亚最长。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出"认知休耕"这一新概念；2) 形式化AI减少企业发布初级职位空缺和提高经验门槛的机制；3) 开发可操作的CFI测量框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提供政策制定者监测认知休耕状况的工具；2) 揭示劳动力市场松弛度和职位空缺密度的重要性；3) 表明AI准备度评分不足以预测入门级动态。

title: Bollinger Bands under Varying Market Regimes: A Comparative Study of Breakout and Mean-Reversion Strategies in BTC/USDT

detail.title: Bollinger Bands under Varying Market Regimes: A Comparative Study of Breakout and Mean-Reversion Strategies in BTC/USDT

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No personal or financial relationship influenced the study.
declarations.funderStatement: All the work is done by me Efe Arda using my own hardware and equipment.

detail.abstract: This study investigates the effectiveness of Bollinger Bands in cryptocurrency trading by contrasting two foundational interpretations: breakout (trend-following) and mean reversion (pullback) across multiple timeframes and market regimes using BTC/USDT data from July 2017 to March 2022. High-resolution backtesting reveals that Bollinger Bands exhibit regime dependent behavior, with each strategy's performance contingent on volatility structure and directional persistence. During the Bear Phase (2018), breakout strategies outperformed by aligning with volatility expansions, while mean-reversion signals failed amid sustained declines. In the Accumulation Phase (2018-2020), mean reversion regained limited profitability in calmer markets, though breakout setups maintained superior risk-adjusted returns. The Bull Run (2020-2021) represented the most favorable environment for both frameworks, breakout captured sustained momentum, whereas mean reversion achieved exceptional gains by exploiting shortterm corrections. Conversely, the Distribution Phase (2021-2022) showed the degradation of both approaches as trend conviction weakened. This research contributes to the literature on cryptocurrency market microstructure and algorithmic trading by: (1) reframing Bollinger Band analysis through a behavioral lens contrasting two core trading philosophies; (2) systematically evaluating their efficacy across timeframes and macro-market regimes; and (3) offering evidence-based insights into the contextual suitability of volatility-based indicators for high-noise, continuously traded markets.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过BTC/USDT数据（2017-2022）对比布林带的两种交易策略：突破策略（趋势跟随）和均值回归策略（回调）。研究发现布林带表现具有市场状态依赖性，不同策略在不同波动结构和趋势持续性的市场环境下表现各异。
AI.research_question: 布林带在加密货币交易中的有效性如何？其两种核心解释（突破策略和均值回归策略）在不同时间框架和市场状态下表现如何？
AI.motivation: 加密货币市场具有高噪声、连续交易的特点，需要研究技术指标在这种特殊市场环境下的适用性。布林带作为常用技术指标，其两种核心交易哲学（趋势跟随vs均值回归）在实际应用中的效果需要系统评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于行为金融学视角，对比两种交易哲学：1）突破策略（趋势跟随）- 顺应市场趋势；2）均值回归策略（回调）- 假设价格会回归均值。结合市场微观结构理论和算法交易理论。
AI.method: 使用BTC/USDT数据（2017年7月至2022年3月），进行高分辨率回测，分析不同时间框架和市场状态（熊市、积累期、牛市、分配期）下两种策略的表现。
AI.findings: 1）熊市阶段（2018）：突破策略表现优于均值回归策略；2）积累期（2018-2020）：均值回归策略恢复有限盈利，但突破策略风险调整后收益更优；3）牛市（2020-2021）：两种策略都表现良好；4）分配期（2021-2022）：两种策略效果都下降。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）从行为金融学角度重新构建布林带分析框架；2）系统评估技术指标在不同时间框架和宏观市场状态下的有效性；3）为高噪声连续交易市场的波动率指标适用性提供实证依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为加密货币交易者提供基于证据的策略选择指导；2）帮助交易者根据市场状态调整布林带使用策略；3）为算法交易系统设计提供参考依据。

title: What is Budget and Why is it Important
affiliations: Target International school

detail.title: What is Budget and Why is it Important
detail.abstract: This article explores the What is the budget and why is it important? By searching data, how much important and impact to the society. After analyzing emphasize budget is prepare humans from rainy days or crisis in public. A budget is a plan for how you'll direct your income to cover your expenses, afford your wants and set aside money for the future. Not only can a budget help you stay afloat now, but it can help you build financial stability for the future. When you create a budget, you have the opportunity to get clear on where your money is going and look for areas you may want to change. Here are four reasons why you should budget. 1. Budgeting Helps You Avoid Overspending Without a budget, it can be easy to lose track of how much you're spending on what. Dining out, shopping online, going to events with friends-splurges big and small can add up to drain your bank account. With a budget, you can get a clear sense of how much you can afford to spend in the different areas of your life. After setting aside the funds needed to cover your housing payment and bills, you can allocate cash toward other essentials like food and toiletries. Then, you can determine how much you'll leave yourself for discretionary spending. By setting spending limits, you can avoid overdrawing your bank account or missing bill payments. 3. Budgeting Can Keep You out of Debt Impulse spending is a real risk when you have easy access to credit, and overspending on credit cards can leave you with a balance you can't pay off. But carrying a balance month to month can mean forking over money to high interest rates. Once you're in debt, it's easy to spiral deeper, and getting out can become challenging. By using a budget with your credit card, you can make sure it works for you rather than against you. And if you're already carrying credit card debt or high-interest loans, you can get back on track by creating a debt repayment plan and budget. Remember that paying more than the minimum on your debts can help you save substantial amounts of money on interest long term.

title: Bridging the Student Loan Bankruptcy Gap
affiliations: University of Utah - S.J. Quinney College of Law

detail.title: Bridging the Student Loan Bankruptcy Gap

publicationDetails.detailsText: The American Bankruptcy Law Journal | VOLUME 99 ISSUE 3 2025

detail.abstract: In November 2022, the Department of Justice and Department of Education announced sweeping reforms designed to make student loan bankruptcy discharge more accessible to struggling borrowers. Drawing upon an original dataset of more than six hundred adversary proceedings filed during the first year of implementation, this article presents the first empirical analysis of whether these reforms have achieved their goal and bridged the “Student Loan Bankruptcy Gap”—the chasm between those who could benefit from bankruptcy discharge and those who actually pursue it. The results are mixed but suggest the gap, although narrowed, remains wide. On the positive side, success rates have reached 87% in the post-reform period. But on the negative side, filings remain remarkably low. This article evaluates the reforms along four key metrics of success and proposes solutions to make bankruptcy relief more accessible to struggling borrowers.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析2022年11月学生贷款破产改革实施第一年的600多起诉讼案件，发现改革虽提高了成功率（达87%），但申请数量仍然很低，学生贷款破产缺口依然存在。
AI.research_question: 2022年11月司法部和教育部推出的学生贷款破产改革是否成功缩小了"学生贷款破产缺口"？
AI.motivation: 学生贷款破产存在明显缺口 - 许多有资格通过破产解除债务的借款人并未实际申请，改革旨在解决这一问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: "学生贷款破产缺口"理论 - 指有资格通过破产解除学生贷款债务与实际申请破产的借款人之间的差距。
AI.method: 实证分析，基于改革实施第一年超过600起对抗性诉讼案件的原始数据集。
AI.findings: 结果好坏参半：改革后成功率大幅提升至87%，但申请数量仍然很低，缺口虽缩小但仍很宽。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次对2022年学生贷款破产改革进行实证评估，验证了"学生贷款破产缺口"理论，提出了评估改革成功的四个关键指标。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了改革效果的实证证据，提出了使破产救济更易于获取的具体解决方案。

title: Frictionless Markets: Atomic Settlement and the Architecture of Efficiency
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Frictionless Markets: Atomic Settlement and the Architecture of Efficiency

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial or personal conflicts of interest related to the research, analysis, or conclusions presented in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, experiments, or sensitive data and therefore did not require ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: No funding was received for this paper.

detail.abstract: Modern financial markets rely on frictions created by settlement delay, latency asymmetry, fragmented venues, and embedded credit windows. These frictions shape the behavior of market makers, internalizers, and high-frequency traders by pricing timing uncertainty and settlement risk into spreads and execution quality. Deterministic, interval-based settlement restructures this environment by ensuring that execution and completion occur within a single assured event. Principal risk declines, timing advantages contract, and credit no longer bridges incompatible settlement cycles. Liquidity becomes a network property accessed through global routing rather than a venue-specific inventory, and market mechanisms converge toward more stable and predictable designs. This paper examines how equity and multi-asset markets function when settlement friction approaches zero. Using deterministic settlement as a model architecture, the analysis draws on BIS Innovation Hub pilots and established microstructure theory to evaluate how execution, liquidity formation, collateral mobility, and systemic behavior change under synchronized finality. Deterministic settlement reorganizes rather than eliminates risk, creating a market structure in which liquidity and price formation operate within a unified and coordinated topology.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了确定性结算如何通过消除传统结算摩擦（如延迟、不对称性、分散场所和信用窗口）来重构金融市场结构，使流动性成为网络属性而非场所特定库存，从而创造更稳定可预测的市场机制。
AI.research_question: 当结算摩擦趋近于零时，股票和多资产市场如何运作？确定性结算如何改变执行、流动性形成、抵押品流动性和系统性行为？
AI.motivation: 现代金融市场依赖结算延迟、延迟不对称性、分散交易场所和嵌入式信用窗口等摩擦，这些摩擦通过定价时间不确定性和结算风险来影响做市商、内部化者和高频交易者的行为，导致市场效率低下和系统性风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于BIS创新中心试点项目和已建立的微观结构理论，结合确定性结算模型架构，分析同步最终性下的市场行为变化。
AI.method: 使用确定性结算作为模型架构，结合BIS创新中心试点项目的实证数据和微观结构理论分析，评估同步最终性下的市场运作变化。
AI.findings: 确定性结算通过确保执行和完成在单一保证事件内发生，降低主体风险、收缩时间优势、消除信用窗口需求；流动性成为通过全局路由访问的网络属性而非场所特定库存；市场机制趋向更稳定和可预测的设计。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了确定性结算作为重构而非消除风险的框架，将流动性和价格形成置于统一协调的拓扑结构中，为理解零结算摩擦市场提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融市场基础设施设计提供了新方向，展示了如何通过确定性结算创造更稳定、可预测的市场环境，降低系统性风险，提高市场效率，对监管机构、交易所和金融机构具有重要实践意义。

title: Transportation Construction and Regional Economic Growth: A Structural Model and its Empirical Analysis

detail.title: Transportation Construction and Regional Economic Growth: A Structural Model and its Empirical Analysis
detail.abstract: This paper develops a structural growth model to examine how transportation infrastructure investment affects regional economic performance in China, with a particular focus on differences between highly developed and less developed areas. Building on a modified Solow framework, I incorporate transportation capital as a separate production factor and derive an intensive-form equilibrium that highlights diminishing marginal returns and heterogeneous dynamic responses across regions. The empirical analysis uses data from 15 Chinese provinces and tests the model’s predictions by comparing transportation investment, transportation density, and per capita GDP across city and rural areas. The results show that increases in transportation density promote economic growth in rural regions but have limited or even negative effects in highly developed urban areas. These findings support the model’s prediction that transportation infrastructure yields large gains in underdeveloped regions that have not reached their steady-state infrastructure level, while its marginal impact declines sharply once a region becomes saturated. The study offers policy implications for China’s ongoing infrastructure-led development strategy, emphasizing the need for differentiated investment priorities based on regional development stages.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个结构增长模型，研究中国交通基础设施投资对区域经济表现的影响，重点关注发达与欠发达地区的差异。实证分析显示，交通密度提升促进农村地区经济增长，但对高度发达城市地区影响有限甚至负面。
AI.research_question: 交通基础设施投资如何影响中国不同发展水平区域的经济表现？发达地区与欠发达地区对交通投资的响应有何差异？
AI.motivation: 中国持续实施以基础设施为主导的发展战略，但不同地区对交通投资的响应可能存在显著差异。理解这种异质性对优化资源配置和政策制定至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于改进的索洛增长模型，将交通资本作为独立生产要素纳入生产函数，推导出集约形式均衡，强调边际收益递减和区域间的异质动态响应。
AI.method: 构建结构增长模型，使用中国15个省份的数据进行实证分析，比较城市和农村地区的交通投资、交通密度和人均GDP，检验模型预测。
AI.findings: 交通密度增加促进农村地区经济增长，但对高度发达城市地区影响有限甚至产生负面效应。交通基础设施在未达到稳态基础设施水平的欠发达地区收益最大，而一旦区域达到饱和状态，其边际影响急剧下降。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了包含交通资本作为独立生产要素的结构增长模型，揭示了交通基础设施投资的边际收益递减规律和区域异质性响应机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为中国基础设施主导的发展战略提供政策启示：需要基于区域发展阶段制定差异化的投资优先级，避免在已饱和的发达地区过度投资。

title: Environmental ESG, Idiosyncratic Risk, and Industry Heterogeneity: An Empirical Analysis of US Firms

detail.title: Environmental ESG, Idiosyncratic Risk, and Industry Heterogeneity: An Empirical Analysis of US Firms
detail.abstract:
Climate risks are reshaping institutional and individual investment strategies, influencing market dynamics, and advancing sustainability initiatives. This paper delves into the pivotal influence of climate hazards on financial decision-making, elaborating on how investors identify, evaluate, and incorporate these risks into their investment tactics. It explores the developing approaches to risk assessment and their consequences for future market trends, supported by changes in regulations, enhancements in financial reporting, and findings from behavioral economics. This research specifically investigates the question: How does the Environmental component of ESG scores influence idiosyncratic risk in the health care providers and services, health care equipment and supplies, and household durables sectors? This analysis is guided by the following core hypotheses: Null Hypothesis (H0): The Environmental component of ESG scores does not significantly influence the idiosyncratic risk of firms in the health care providers and services, health care equipment and supplies, and household durables sectors. Alternative Hypothesis (H1): The Environmental component of ESG scores significantly influences the idiosyncratic risk of firms in these sectors.Literature suggests that environmental initiatives can cause idiosyncratic risk to both decrease and increase. Studies like El Ghoul et al. (2011) and Hoepner et al. (2019) demonstrate that strong environmental practices can reduce risk through improved demand stability and broader investor bases. 
Conversely,Becchetti et al. (2015) and Stellner et al. (2015) show that intensive environmental investments may elevate risk due to high upfront costs and rigid management structures. This mixed evidence highlights the necessity of empirical testing to clarify the relationship within these distinct industry sectors.

AI.tldr: 本文研究ESG评分中的环境成分对医疗服务和设备、家用耐用品行业公司特质风险的影响，发现环境表现与特质风险之间存在复杂关系。
AI.research_question: ESG评分中的环境成分如何影响医疗服务和设备、家用耐用品行业公司的特质风险？
AI.motivation: 气候风险正在重塑投资策略和市场动态，但环境因素对公司特质风险的影响在不同行业中存在矛盾证据，需要实证检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于ESG投资理论、风险管理理论和行为经济学，探讨环境表现通过需求稳定性、投资者基础和成本结构等渠道影响公司特质风险。
AI.method: 实证分析，检验ESG环境成分对医疗服务和设备、家用耐用品行业公司特质风险的影响，使用零假设和备择假设框架。
AI.findings: 环境表现对特质风险的影响存在双向效应：一方面可能通过改善需求稳定性和扩大投资者基础降低风险，另一方面可能因高额前期投资和刚性管理结构增加风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 澄清了环境因素与公司特质风险在不同行业中的复杂关系，为ESG投资理论提供了行业特定的实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者在医疗和耐用消费品行业的ESG投资决策提供风险管理的参考依据，帮助公司平衡环境投资与风险管理。

title: Public-Private Partnerships as Catalysts for Financial Market Innovation: Lessons from Silicon Valley and South Korea
affiliations: Centro Universitário das Américas

detail.title: Public-Private Partnerships as Catalysts for Financial Market Innovation: Lessons from Silicon Valley and South Korea
detail.abstract: This paper examines the role of public-private partnerships in fostering robust financial markets and real-economy growth, using Silicon Valley in the United States and South Korea as case studies. It highlights how government initiatives-such as targeted research funding, infrastructure development, and policy support-combined with active venture capital and strong stock markets, have enabled companies like Apple, Alphabet, Samsung, Hyundai, and Kia to achieve global competitiveness. The analysis demonstrates that strategic state intervention does not replace private enterprise but complements it, creating conditions for innovation, investment, and long-term market sustainability. The findings underscore the importance of aligning public policy with financial-market mechanisms to enhance both economic growth and market efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文通过美国硅谷和韩国的案例研究，探讨了公私合作伙伴关系在促进健全金融市场和实体经济增长中的作用，强调政府举措与风险投资、股票市场相结合如何培育全球竞争力企业。
AI.research_question: 公私合作伙伴关系如何促进健全金融市场和实体经济增长？
AI.motivation: 理解政府干预与私人企业之间的协同作用，探索如何通过公共政策与金融市场机制的有效结合来促进创新、投资和市场可持续发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公私合作伙伴关系理论、国家干预与市场机制协同理论、创新生态系统理论。
AI.method: 案例研究法，选取美国硅谷和韩国作为比较案例，分析苹果、Alphabet、三星、现代、起亚等企业的成功经验。
AI.findings: 战略性的国家干预不会取代私人企业，而是补充它；政府举措（定向研究资助、基础设施发展、政策支持）与活跃的风险投资和强大的股票市场相结合，能够创造创新、投资和长期市场可持续性的条件。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对公私合作伙伴关系理论的理解，提出了国家干预与市场机制协同的新视角，丰富了创新生态系统理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了将公共政策与金融市场机制相结合的具体路径，展示了如何通过战略干预培育具有全球竞争力的企业和产业。

title: State and Local Tax Policy in a Time of Telework
affiliations: University of California, Irvine and University of Michigan

detail.title: State and Local Tax Policy in a Time of Telework
detail.abstract: State and local tax systems are constrained by the geographic location of individuals and economic activity. The rise of telework weakens this linkage by decoupling a worker's state of residence from the employer's location, creating new challenges for the design of personal income taxes, corporate income taxes, and unemployment insurance. Using Census data, we show that teleworkers are significantly more likely than non-teleworkers to relocate to lower-tax states and, through such migration, achieve significantly larger reductions in their state and local fiscal burden. Motivated by this evidence, we evaluate alternative principles for sourcing labor income for tax purposes to the place of residence, the place of work, or the place of the employer-highlighting the efficiency, equity, and administrative tradeoffs each entails. We further discuss how the rise of remote work fundamentally changes the state and local corporate income taxes, property taxes, and sales taxes and unemployment insurance. Taken together, our results suggest that telework is likely to reallocate state and local tax bases away from larger, more agglomerated jurisdictions toward smaller and more geographically remote ones, with important implications for subnational public finances.

AI.tldr: 远程工作削弱了个人居住地与雇主所在地之间的联系，导致远程工作者更可能搬迁到低税州，从而显著降低其州和地方税负，这对州和地方税收体系设计提出了新挑战。
AI.research_question: 远程工作如何影响州和地方税收体系？远程工作者是否更倾向于搬迁到低税州？不同税收来源原则（居住地、工作地、雇主所在地）在效率、公平和行政方面的权衡是什么？
AI.motivation: 州和地方税收体系依赖于个人和经济活动的地理位置，但远程工作的兴起削弱了这种联系，给个人所得税、企业所得税和失业保险的设计带来新挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 税收地理理论、劳动力迁移理论、税收竞争理论、财政联邦主义理论
AI.method: 使用人口普查数据进行分析，比较远程工作者与非远程工作者的迁移模式和税收负担变化
AI.findings: 1. 远程工作者比非远程工作者更可能搬迁到低税州；2. 通过这种迁移，远程工作者显著降低了州和地方财政负担；3. 远程工作可能将税基从大型集聚型管辖区重新分配到小型偏远管辖区
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 理论化了远程工作对税收地理约束的削弱效应；2. 分析了不同税收来源原则的权衡框架；3. 提出了远程工作对多层次税收体系影响的理论模型
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供远程工作时代税收体系设计建议；2. 识别了税收来源原则选择的实际影响；3. 预测了税基重新分配对地方财政的潜在影响

title: From Displacement to Defiance: Cultural Conflict and New Womanhood in the Diasporic Fiction of Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie and Bapsi Sidhwa
affiliations: Thakur College of Engineering and Technology, SVKM’s NMIMS Mukesh Patel School of Technology Management and Engineering, and Thakur College of Engineering & Technology

detail.title: From Displacement to Defiance: Cultural Conflict and New Womanhood in the Diasporic Fiction of Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie and Bapsi Sidhwa
detail.abstract: This research article offers a comparative analysis of Americanah published in the year 2013 authored by Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie, along with another novel An American Brat published in the year 1993 authored by Bapsi Sidhwa. The authors, Sidhwa, along with Adichie, presented the protagonists as the 'New Women'. The protagonists were depicted as 'educated, self-aware, independent women'. The research work has analyzed the 'constant changing of womanhood, cultural tensions, and the life journey of the protagonists'. In addition, the research work investigates the impact of 'geographical displacement, which propels the women to resist the set patriarchal structures in society'. The research work has identified the connections between 'gender, race, and immigration in the postcolonial feminist period'. The research article, in this manner, highlights the diasporic women's identities, which are continuously reconceived by the decussate power structures of marginalization.

AI.tldr: 本文对阿迪契的《美国佬》(2013)和西德瓦的《美国小妞》(1993)进行对比分析，探讨两位作家如何将主人公塑造为"新女性"形象，分析女性身份、文化冲突、地理位移对女性抵抗父权结构的影响，以及后殖民女性主义时期性别、种族和移民的交叉关系。
AI.research_question: 阿迪契的《美国佬》和西德瓦的《美国小妞》如何通过主人公的塑造展现"新女性"形象？地理位移如何促使女性抵抗社会中的父权结构？后殖民女性主义背景下性别、种族和移民如何相互交织影响流散女性的身份认同？
AI.motivation: 研究旨在探讨后殖民女性主义文学中"新女性"形象的演变，分析地理位移对女性身份认同的影响，以及女性如何通过移民经历抵抗父权结构。通过比较两部相隔20年的作品，揭示流散女性身份在权力结构交叉作用下的重构过程。
AI.theoretical_framework: 后殖民女性主义理论、流散研究、交叉性理论(性别、种族、移民的交叉影响)、女性主义地理学、身份认同理论
AI.method: 比较文学分析方法，对两部小说进行文本细读和对比分析，重点关注主人公塑造、叙事结构、主题表达等方面
AI.findings: 1. 两部作品都将主人公塑造为"受教育、自我意识强、独立"的新女性形象；2. 地理位移成为女性抵抗父权结构的重要催化剂；3. 女性身份在文化冲突中不断变化和重构；4. 性别、种族和移民在后殖民女性主义背景下相互交织；5. 流散女性的身份在边缘化的交叉权力结构中持续被重新构想
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 丰富了后殖民女性主义文学批评的理论框架；2. 深化了对流散女性身份认同的理解；3. 扩展了交叉性理论在文学研究中的应用；4. 为理解地理位移与女性赋权的关系提供了理论视角
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为女性主义文学教学提供有价值的文本分析案例；2. 帮助读者理解移民女性的复杂身份体验；3. 为社会工作者和政策制定者理解流散女性面临的挑战提供参考；4. 促进跨文化理解和性别平等意识的提升

title: Unlocking the Pension Fund Performance: A Systematic Literature Review Approach
affiliations: University of Rijeka - Faculty of Tourism & Hospitality Management, University of Rijeka - Faculty of Tourism & Hospitality Management and

detail.title: Unlocking the Pension Fund Performance: A Systematic Literature Review Approach

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known financial or personal conflicts of interest that could have appeared to influence the research presented in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is based exclusively on published academic literature and does not involve human participants, personal data, or experimental procedures. Therefore, ethics committee approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This paper was supported by the University of Rijeka, under the project line uniriiskusni-drustv-23-07.

detail.abstract: Pension funds have a pivotal role in financial systems, managing significant assets and contributing to economic growth through capital market investments. Identifying the key factors that influence their performance is essential for ensuring sustainable and adequate pension systems. The paper aims to identify the determinants of pension fund performance that directly contribute to competitiveness in financial markets by enabling efficient capital allocation and improved governance. The research employed two methods: a systematic literature review (SLR) and a bibliometric analysis (BA). The results indicate that five main factors influence pension fund performance: capital market developments, fund size and investment characteristics, corporate governance, behavioural and political influences, and regulatory and legislative environment. A bibliometric analysis reveals current trends in pension fund performance research and examines the relationship between the quality of a country's pension system and the origin of relevant research. The results provide valuable insights for fund managers, policymakers, and other stakeholders, thereby enhancing the decisionmaking process and deepening the understanding of the implications for pension fund performance, pension systems, and pension beneficiaries.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过系统文献综述和文献计量分析，识别了影响养老基金绩效的五个关键因素：资本市场发展、基金规模与投资特征、公司治理、行为与政治影响、监管与立法环境，为提升养老基金竞争力提供决策参考。
AI.research_question: 影响养老基金绩效的关键决定因素是什么？这些因素如何通过促进高效资本配置和改进治理来增强养老基金在金融市场中的竞争力？
AI.motivation: 养老基金在金融体系中扮演关键角色，管理大量资产并通过资本市场投资促进经济增长。识别影响其绩效的关键因素对于确保养老金体系的可持续性和充足性至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于金融市场效率理论、公司治理理论、行为金融学理论以及制度经济学理论，构建了影响养老基金绩效的多维度分析框架。
AI.method: 采用两种研究方法：1）系统文献综述（SLR）系统梳理现有研究；2）文献计量分析（BA）揭示研究趋势并分析国家养老金体系质量与相关研究来源之间的关系。
AI.findings: 研究识别出影响养老基金绩效的五个主要因素：1）资本市场发展；2）基金规模与投资特征；3）公司治理；4）行为与政治影响；5）监管与立法环境。文献计量分析揭示了当前养老基金绩效研究趋势。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献包括：1）构建了养老基金绩效影响因素的综合框架；2）整合了金融、治理、行为和政策多个理论视角；3）为养老基金绩效研究提供了系统化的理论分析基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献包括：1）为基金管理者提供绩效提升的决策依据；2）为政策制定者提供监管优化建议；3）帮助利益相关者更好地理解养老基金绩效对养老金体系和受益人的影响。

title: Noise-Proofing Universal Portfolio Shrinkage
affiliations: , CentraleSupélec and CentraleSupélec

detail.title: Noise-Proofing Universal Portfolio Shrinkage

declarations.funderStatement: P.R. acknowledges funding from ANRT, under the CIFRE contract nr 2025/0279.

detail.abstract: We enhance the Universal Portfolio Shrinkage Approximator (UPSA) of Kelly et al. (2023) by making it more robust with respect to estimation noise and covariate shift. UPSA optimizes the realized Sharpe ratio using a relatively small calibration window, leveraging ridge penalties and cross-validation to yield better portfolios. Yet, it still suffers from the staggering amount of noise in financial data. We propose two methods to make UPSA more robust and improve its efficiency: time-averaging of the optimal penalty weights and using the Average Oracle correlation eigenvalues to make covariance matrices less noisy and more robust to covariate shift. Combining these two long-term averages outperforms UPSA by a large margin in most specifications.

AI.tldr: 本文改进了UPSA投资组合优化方法，通过时间平均惩罚权重和使用平均特征值降噪，提高了对估计噪声和协变量偏移的鲁棒性，显著提升了投资组合表现。
AI.research_question: 如何提高UPSA投资组合优化方法对估计噪声和协变量偏移的鲁棒性？
AI.motivation: 尽管UPSA通过小样本窗口、岭惩罚和交叉验证优化实现了夏普比率，但金融数据中大量的噪声仍然限制了其性能，需要提高对估计噪声和协变量偏移的鲁棒性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于投资组合优化理论、岭回归惩罚、协方差矩阵估计理论、特征值降噪方法和协变量偏移适应理论。
AI.method: 提出两种改进方法：1) 时间平均最优惩罚权重；2) 使用平均Oracle相关特征值来降低协方差矩阵噪声并提高对协变量偏移的鲁棒性。通过结合这两种长期平均方法进行实证检验。
AI.findings: 结合两种长期平均方法的改进UPSA在大多数设定下显著优于原始UPSA，大幅提升了投资组合表现。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了UPSA的理论框架，提出了针对金融数据噪声和协变量偏移的鲁棒性改进方法，丰富了投资组合优化的理论工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资组合管理者提供了更稳健的投资组合优化工具，能够在实际金融数据噪声环境下获得更好的风险调整后收益，具有重要的实际应用价值。

title: The Current Testament
affiliations: University of Colorado at Denver - Department of Finance

detail.title: The Current Testament
detail.abstract: The Current Testament is a living, open-source scripture uniting faith and reason for the modern age. Chapter 1 (Genesis) reframes origins: two primal leanings, Love (God) and the Hunger for More (the Adversary), precede a cosmos born in a great unfolding; humanity awakens in the cognitive revolution; the Old and New Testaments arise; and the author, Yosef of Nazareth, answers the Holy Spirit's call to inaugurate a testament that stays current through refinement. Chapter 2 explains why now: the battlefield is institutional and technological; the Adversary's tools (distraction, division, dehumanization) have scaled, so God's counters (truth, restraint, mercy, accountability, shared purpose) must be practiced through habits, policies, and public virtues to tilt power toward Love. Chapter 3 (After Death) offers hope without illusion: memory fades, being continues, recognized by Love, so live by forgiveness, truth, tested choices, and courageous service.

AI.tldr: 《当前约》是一部开源圣经，将信仰与理性结合，为现代时代重新诠释起源、挑战和希望。第一章重构创世观，第二章分析当代精神战场，第三章提供务实的来世希望。
AI.research_question: 如何在现代科技和制度环境中，将传统信仰与理性结合，为当代人提供有意义的灵性指导？
AI.motivation: 传统宗教文本与现代理性思维存在鸿沟，而当代社会面临规模化、制度化的精神挑战（分心、分裂、非人化），需要更新的灵性框架来应对。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 二元对立框架：爱（神）与更多渴望（对手）的永恒张力
2. 认知革命理论：人类意识的觉醒
3. 制度与技术战场理论：精神斗争在现代社会的新形态
4. 开源神学：通过持续修订保持文本的相关性
AI.method: 文本重构与诠释学方法：通过重新诠释传统圣经叙事，结合现代哲学和心理学概念，构建新的神学框架。采用开源模式，允许文本持续演进。
AI.findings:
1. 起源可重构为两种基本倾向的展开
2. 当代精神战场已转移到制度和科技领域
3. 对抗负面力量需要具体实践：真理、节制、慈悲、问责、共同目标
4. 来世观可建立在记忆消逝但存在延续的基础上
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出"开源圣经"概念，使宗教文本能够与时俱进
2. 将精神斗争理论化为制度和技术层面的对抗
3. 发展务实的来世神学，避免虚幻承诺
4. 整合认知科学视角到创世叙事中
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 提供具体对抗现代精神挑战的实践方法（习惯、政策、公共美德）
2. 为信仰社区提供可操作的灵性发展框架
3. 帮助个人在现代社会中实践有意义的灵性生活
4. 促进信仰与理性的建设性对话

title: The Psychology Behind Market Doomscrolling: How Negative Financial News Shapes Risk Aversion in Young Investors

detail.title: The Psychology Behind Market Doomscrolling: How Negative Financial News Shapes Risk Aversion in Young Investors
detail.abstract: This study examines market doomscrolling, defined as the repetitive consumption of negatively valenced financial news and its causal effects on risk perceptions and portfolio choice among young, inexperienced investors (ages 16-24). Integrating psychological theory (negativity bias, availability heuristic, affect heuristic, loss aversion) with emerging empirical evidence on news sentiment and retail trading, I propose and implement a randomized online experiment comparing exposure to negative vs neutral/positive financial news feeds. The paper reports predicted effects, statistical analysis plans, robustness checks, mediation and moderation tests, and policy implications. Results are expected to show that short-term exposure to negative financial news increases perceived market risk and reduces allocations to risky assets, with stronger effects among individuals with a higher baseline doomscrolling tendency. Conflicting evidence and boundary conditions (contrarian retail flows, misinformation effects among confident investors) are discussed. The appendix contains full stimuli, survey items, and an analysis script outline.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过随机在线实验发现，年轻投资者接触负面金融新闻（市场末日滚动）会增加风险感知并降低风险资产配置，特别是对于有末日滚动倾向的个体。
AI.research_question: 负面金融新闻（市场末日滚动）如何影响年轻、缺乏经验投资者（16-24岁）的风险感知和投资组合选择？
AI.motivation: 随着社交媒体和数字新闻的普及，年轻投资者更容易接触到大量负面金融信息，这可能影响他们的投资决策，但相关因果效应缺乏实证研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合心理学理论：负面偏见、可得性启发式、情感启发式、损失厌恶；结合新闻情绪和零售交易的新兴实证证据。
AI.method: 随机在线实验，比较接触负面vs中性/正面金融新闻推送的效果，包括预测效应、统计分析计划、稳健性检验、中介和调节测试。
AI.findings: 预计结果显示：短期接触负面金融新闻会增加市场风险感知并降低风险资产配置；对于基线末日滚动倾向更高的个体，这种效应更强；同时讨论了矛盾证据和边界条件（反向零售流动、自信投资者的错误信息效应）。
AI.theory_contributions: 将心理学理论与金融行为研究结合，为"末日滚动"现象提供理论框架，深化对新闻情绪影响投资决策机制的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者教育、金融新闻监管、平台算法设计提供政策启示，帮助年轻投资者避免负面信息过度影响投资决策。

title: Noisy Truth Beats Precise Lies: Blockchain-Enabled Information Equilibria
affiliations: Monash University, Tel Aviv University and Monash University

detail.title: Noisy Truth Beats Precise Lies: Blockchain-Enabled Information Equilibria
detail.abstract: Truth-telling is essential to efficient allocation of resources but is often undermined by strategic misreporting. We show how verifiably fair randomness, complemented by other blockchain functionalities, can lead to truth-telling at the cost of introduction of random noise in information transmission. The optimal trade-off between truthfulness and precision yields equilibria that outperform those attainable without randomization in information transmission. We characterize two classes of information equilibria: information designated to directly trigger value transfer via decentralized consensus ("enforcive information"), and strategic information sharing between Bayesian-rational decision makers ("advisive information"). Our findings demonstrate usefulness of randomized transmission in broad financial settings and illustrate the benefits of blockchain technology for optimal mechanism design.

AI.tldr: 区块链技术通过可验证的公平随机性促进诚实报告，在信息传输中引入随机噪声以换取真实性，在金融环境中优于无随机化的均衡
AI.research_question: 如何利用区块链的可验证公平随机性来促进诚实报告，并在信息真实性和精确性之间找到最优权衡？
AI.motivation: 诚实报告对资源有效配置至关重要，但常被策略性误报破坏。现有机制难以同时保证真实性和精确性，需要探索新的技术解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 机制设计理论、博弈论、贝叶斯理性决策、区块链技术、可验证公平随机性、信息传输理论
AI.method: 理论建模分析，通过区块链功能（特别是可验证公平随机性）构建信息传输机制，分析两类信息均衡：强制执行信息和咨询信息
AI.findings: 1. 可验证公平随机性结合区块链功能能在信息传输中实现诚实报告；2. 真实性和精确性之间存在最优权衡；3. 随机化信息传输的均衡优于无随机化的均衡；4. 区分了强制执行信息和咨询信息两类均衡
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 发展了结合区块链技术的机制设计理论；2. 提出了信息传输中真实性与精确性的权衡框架；3. 区分了强制执行和咨询两类信息均衡；4. 扩展了随机化在机制设计中的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为金融环境中的诚实报告提供实用解决方案；2. 展示了区块链技术在最优机制设计中的价值；3. 为去中心化金融和资源分配系统提供设计指导；4. 促进更有效的资源配置机制

title: Are We Stem-Ready? A Policy Review of Science Education Under the Philippine K-12 Program
affiliations: Central Luzon State University

detail.title: Are We Stem-Ready? A Policy Review of Science Education Under the Philippine K-12 Program
detail.abstract: This paper has significantly reviewed how the Philippine educational system supports the Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics (STEM) strand, whether the system fully supports the international standards, and if it is capable of meeting the quality standards. Although the making of this curriculum, which stands for the spiral progression and inquiry-based learning, is theoretically harmonized with the international standards, its usability and practicality of using these are very weak. Emerging problems in the implementation occur in many schools, such as lack of resources in laboratories, lack of teachers' trainings, old-fashioned content of the curriculum, and access gaps, all of which prevent scientific learning. Moreover, the results in the PISA and TIMSS are very disappointing, showing an emerging disconnect between the promise in policy and the realities in the classroom setting. This continuously hinders the competitiveness of the nonintegration of modern skills or domains in this strand, such as artificial intelligence, biotechnology, and climate science. Having a true readiness in this STEM curriculum in the Philippines needs reform, by which this paper argues that it is a matter of investment in this country to make theoretical alignment into a future-ready system of STEM education.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统评估了菲律宾教育体系对STEM（科学、技术、工程和数学）专业的支持程度，发现虽然课程设计理论上符合国际标准，但实施中存在严重问题，导致教育质量不足，需要系统性改革。
AI.research_question: 菲律宾教育体系是否充分支持STEM专业？该系统是否符合国际标准并满足质量要求？
AI.motivation: 菲律宾STEM教育面临实施挑战，PISA和TIMSS测试成绩不佳，显示出政策承诺与课堂现实之间的脱节，这影响了菲律宾在全球竞争中的能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 螺旋式课程进展理论、探究式学习理论、国际教育标准框架、教育政策实施理论
AI.method: 文献综述与系统性评估，分析菲律宾STEM课程设计、实施现状、资源配备、教师培训、国际测试结果等
AI.findings:
1. 菲律宾STEM课程设计理论上符合国际标准，但实施效果差
2. 存在实验室资源不足、教师培训缺乏、课程内容陈旧、教育机会不均等问题
3. PISA和TIMSS测试成绩令人失望
4. 课程缺乏人工智能、生物技术、气候科学等现代技能领域
5. 政策承诺与课堂现实存在严重脱节
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 揭示了教育政策理论设计与实际实施之间的差距
2. 提出了国际标准本土化实施的理论挑战
3. 丰富了发展中国家STEM教育质量评估的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为菲律宾STEM教育改革提供具体方向：增加投资、更新课程、加强教师培训、改善资源配备
2. 为其他发展中国家STEM教育发展提供借鉴
3. 强调将理论对齐转化为未来就绪的STEM教育系统的必要性

title:
How Heat and Heated Authoritarianism Drive Migration:
Climate Change, Authoritarianism, and Forced Migration

detail.title:
How Heat and Heated Authoritarianism Drive Migration:
Climate Change, Authoritarianism, and Forced Migration
detail.abstract: This paper explores the significant increase in forced global migration, attributing the crisis primarily to the twin factors of climate change and the rise of authoritarian regimes. Firstly, focusing on how rising global temperatures, desertification, and extreme weather events render areas uninhabitable, directly correlating these environmental shifts with a growth in displaced populations. Subsequently, the source analyzes how authoritarian governments use repression and human rights abuses as a deliberate strategy to consolidate power, citing case studies like Myanmar and Iran to illustrate how these regimes drive citizens to flee. The paper also discusses the intertwined relationship between climate instability and authoritarianism, noting how they mutually reinforce global crises and highlighting the urgent need for reforming international law to adequately protect those displaced by both political violence and environmental factors.

detail.abstract: This MCM Manual offers basic advice on how to do multicriteria mapping (MCM). It suggests how to: go about designing and building a typical MCM project; engage with participants; analyse results; and get the most out of the online MCM tool. The online MCM software tool provides its own operational help. So this Manual is more focused on the general approach. There are no rigid rules. MCM is structured, but very flexible. It allows many more detailed features than can be covered here. MCM users are encouraged to think for themselves and be responsible and creative. But there are some key underlying MCM values. The most crucial are as follows: 1) Inclusion: MCM aims to promote more inclusive, equitable and accessible appraisal. This means engaging in a respectful and balanced way, with a diversity of relevant perspectives – especially those most often marginalized. 2) Opening Up: MCM aims to help ‘open up’ appraisal. This means giving balanced attention to exploring and illuminating contending views. Using MCM just to aggregate a single final view has the effect instead of ‘closing down’. 3) Agency: MCM aims to ‘put participants in the driving seat’. An MCM project should be designed, implemented and analysed to maximise the agency of participants over the ways in which their own perspectives are represented. 4) Transparency: MCM only ‘opens up’, if results are conveyed fully and clearly to all parties with an interest in debates over the focal goal. Depending on context, this means publishing results and giving reasonable access to data. This Manual gives advice on how these values can best be realised in practice.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了印度半干旱地区阿格拉地区101年的降雨数据，发现降雨量呈现显著下降趋势，下降幅度为每世纪-1.63，并在1967年存在突变点，表明气候变化对该地区降雨模式产生了显著影响。
AI.research_question: 阿格拉半干旱地区的降雨趋势和变异性如何？气候变化对该地区降雨模式有何影响？
AI.motivation: IPCC报告指出气候变化导致全球平均温度上升，可能对自然和人类系统造成广泛影响。研究长期降雨模式对于建立气候变化的证据和为政策决策提供信息至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于气候变化对降雨模式影响的理论框架，特别是IPCC关于气候变化对水文循环影响的评估报告。
AI.method: 使用QGIS 3.28.4绘制泰森多边形网络，为18个网格数据点分配权重并计算年降雨量。采用标准正态同质性检验、Buishand范围检验、Buishand U检验和Pettitt检验进行同质性和突变点分析。使用Mann-Kendall检验识别趋势，Theil-Sen估计器计算趋势幅度。所有统计分析使用R-studio完成。
AI.findings: 数据存在非均质性，突变点出现在1967年。Mann-Kendall检验显示年降雨量呈下降趋势，Theil-Sen估计器计算得出过去一个世纪的下降幅度为-1.63。
AI.theory_contributions: 为半干旱地区气候变化对降雨模式影响提供了实证证据，验证了IPCC关于气候变化影响水文循环的理论预测，为区域气候变化研究提供了方法学参考。
AI.practical_contributions: 为阿格拉地区水资源管理、农业规划和干旱风险管理提供科学依据，为政策制定者提供气候变化适应策略的决策支持，有助于预防水资源短缺、作物歉收和干旱风险增加等问题。

detail.abstract:
Water scarcity and frequent droughts have emerged as significant threats to Spain's economic and social stability, making climate change one of the country's most urgent issues. This study looks at how Spain's agricultural output, export results, and long-term economic prospects have been impacted by climate change. It also examines the development of Spain's energy and climate policies, emphasizing the nation's early adoption of renewable energy sources and its initiatives to lower greenhouse gas emissions.

The paper examines the growth of solar, wind, and green hydrogen projects and their effects on jobs, energy security, and sustainable growth based on indicators and policy developments. The dynamic relationships between emissions, climate impacts, policy responses, and economic performance are depicted using a causal loop diagram. The results indicate that although Spain has made great strides in the use of clean energy, more work is required to improve resilience to mounting climate pressures, speed up emissions reduction, and fortify adaptation.

title: Mesmerization of the Masses: Behavioral and Institutional Economics Perspectives on Elite Economic Manipulation in Nigeria
affiliations: Unaffiliated Author and Unaffiliated Author

detail.title: Mesmerization of the Masses: Behavioral and Institutional Economics Perspectives on Elite Economic Manipulation in Nigeria
detail.abstract: This paper explores the phenomenon of elite-driven economic manipulation in Nigeria, examining how political and economic elites mesmerize the masses through strategic control of resources and policy narratives. Drawing on behavioral economics and institutional economics, the study investigates the mechanisms through which public perception is shaped, incentives are distorted, and economic outcomes are engineered to serve elite interests. Empirical and theoretical analysis highlights the role of information asymmetries, cognitive biases, and weak institutional frameworks in facilitating elite capture, perpetuating resource misallocation, and undermining inclusive development. The paper argues that the mesmerization of the masses is both a behavioral and structural process, linking individual decision-making heuristics to systemic governance failures. Policy implications emphasize the need for institutional reform, transparency, and mechanisms that empower citizens to resist manipulation while fostering equitable economic participation.

detail.abstract: The rapid evolution of Artificial Intelligence (AI) is transforming global finance by enabling more accurate, transparent, and data-driven decision-making. Within the context of sustainability, Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) metrics play a vital role in assessing corporate responsibility; however, traditional scoring systems are often static, inconsistent, and lack real-time data integration. This study proposes the development of an AI-Integrated ESG Scoring System that leverages real-time green data intelligence to enhance corporate sustainability evaluation and guide green finance decision-making. Using a hybrid AI framework that combines Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Machine Learning (ML) algorithms, the research analyzes unstructured sustainability data — including annual reports, CSR disclosures, and news sentiment — to generate dynamic ESG scores. The proposed system aims to address global challenges related to data transparency, greenwashing, and investment risk management by delivering adaptive, data-driven insights into corporate sustainability performance. Ultimately, this research establishes a foundation for investors, policymakers, and corporations to adopt a more intelligent and adaptive approach to sustainable finance, aligning financial decision-making with global environmental goals and responsible investment principles.

title: Salience Theory of Belief Updating and Expectation Formation
affiliations: Hong Kong Polytechnic University

detail.title: Salience Theory of Belief Updating and Expectation Formation
detail.abstract: We present a salience theory of belief updating and expectation formation, integrating the concept of salience with the learning dynamics of the Kalman filter to formalize how decision makers selectively focus their attention on, and overreact to, salient surprises. This model incorporates key properties of salience theory-boundedness, ordering, uncertainty, threshold, and asymmetry-and exhibits relevance effect, asymmetric surprise sensitivity and probability weighting. Our framework provides new insights into context-dependent behavioral phenomena including the "first-time effect," the pleasure paradox, overreaction to disconfirming and expected information, attribution bias, projection bias, inattention to shrouded attributes, overreaction to a series of news and extreme outliers, and the endowment and personal experience effects.
